title: Product Marketing Manager - Argentina
description: Nuestro equipo de Product Marketing &amp; Lifecycle<br><br>El equipo global de Lifecycle tiene la misión de ayudar a emprendedores a hacer crecer sus negocios, diseñando estrategias que impulsen la activación, retención y lealtad, al mismo tiempo que lidera iniciativas de engagement, comunidad y educación como eventos, programas de formación y experiencias que realmente conecten con nuestra audiencia.<br><br>Estamos buscando una persona para liderar la estrategia de Product Marketing y Lifecycle de Tiendanube en Argentina. Este rol es clave para impulsar el crecimiento y la retención de merchants, asegurando que nuestro posicionamiento, mensajes y estrategias de go-to-market reflejan la madurez del mercado argentino y las particularidades del ecosistema local.<br><br>El tamaño de tu desafío<br><br><ul><li>Liderar el equipo de PMM y Lifecycle Argentina, impulsando el crecimiento, retención y adopción de productos por parte de los merchants;</li><li>Colaborar con los equipos de Brand, Growth Acquisition, Agencies y Sales para alinear la estrategia local con los objetivos globales;</li><li>Actuar como punto de contacto principal para la ejecución local del go-to-market, garantizando coherencia entre marketing, ventas y customer success;</li><li>Traducir lanzamientos y mejoras de producto en estrategias de GTM efectivas y adaptadas al mercado argentino;</li><li>Supervisar las iniciativas de los equipos de PMM Core, PMM Agencies y Lifecycle Education, asegurando posicionamiento consistente y foco en resultados;</li><li>Diseñar y optimizar journeys de CRM y estrategias de nurturing que combinen automatización, IA y contacto humano para maximizar retención y GMV.<br><br></li></ul>Lo que buscamos<br><br><ul><li>Experiencia comprobada en Product Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing o Growth Strategy, idealmente en empresas SaaS, marketplaces o e-commerce;</li><li>Conocimiento sólido de procesos de go-to-market, journey del cliente y segmentación de merchants (SMB/MM);</li><li>Experiencia liderando equipos multifuncionales e influyendo en áreas como Sales, Brand y Growth;</li><li>Mentalidad analítica, con experiencia trabajando con métricas de adopción, churn y GMV;</li><li>Familiaridad con herramientas de marketing automation, CRM y soluciones de IA aplicadas a lifecycle;</li><li>Resiliencia y adaptabilidad para desenvolverse en contextos dinámicos y de cambio constante.</li><li>Disponibilidad para trabajar con una modalidad híbrida (estamos en Nuñez - CABA).<br><br></li></ul>Es un plus<br><br><ul><li>Portugués conversacional.<br><br></li></ul>Nuestro proceso<br><br>Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition va a analizar tu perfil con atención e, independientemente del resultado, vas a recibir una respuesta.<br><br>Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto con vos durante todo el proceso.<br><br>Lo que te proponemos<br><br><ul><li>Cobertura de salud OSDE 310 para el grupo familiar (cónyuge + hijos);</li><li>Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas;</li><li>Reintegro del servicio de Internet;</li><li>Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse;</li><li>La asistencia de guardería es un beneficio que tiene como objetivo apoyar a los colaboradores en la provisión de un entorno seguro para sus hijos desde los 45 días de vida, hasta los 3 años de edad, durante tu jornada laboral;</li><li>Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes;</li><li>15 días hábiles de vacaciones a lo largo del año;</li><li>Además de las vacaciones, disponemos de una semana de descanso para recargar energías entre final/principio de nuevo año;</li><li>Una Tiendanube gratuita para vos o alguien de tu entorno;</li><li>Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación, siempre que el rol lo permita;</li><li>Es un entorno de desafío constante, propósito y protagonismo — acá la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante.<br><br></li></ul>Política de Privacidad<br><br>Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos.<br><br>Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos.<br><br>Para obtener más información sobre cómo manejamos los datos, incluidos tus derechos según la ley, simplemente accedé a nuestra Política de Privacidad.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description: About The Company At OneClick Code, we are revolutionizing the roofing and restoration industry through smart automation, data transparency, and instant access to critical building information. Our mission is to empower contractors, adjusters, and insurance professionals with accurate, jurisdiction-specific codes and permit data, instantly, so they can work smarter, not harder. Founded in 2018, with a vision to eliminate the inefficiencies and guesswork that slow down claims and repairs, OneClick Code has become the go-to platform for accessing trusted roofing codes, manufacturer specifications, tax jurisdiction data, and permit requirements, all in just one click. We're a fast-growing, venture-backed startup that thrives on innovation, collaboration, and impact. As we scale, we're looking for mission-driven team members who are passionate about using technology to bring clarity and confidence to an often-overlooked corner of the construction world. The Opportunity OneClick Data is seeking a Technical Delivery Manager to oversee Agile delivery execution across our Product Engineering, Data Analytics, and Data Acquisition teams. This role is responsible for facilitating Scrum ceremonies, tracking sprint and epic progress, managing delivery risks, coordinating software releases, and providing clear operational visibility to engineering and product leadership. The Technical Delivery Manager serves as the central coordination point across technical teams, ensuring work progresses predictably, dependencies are managed proactively, and stakeholders have accurate insight into delivery status. This role does not own product strategy or backlog prioritization. Priorities are owned by Product Leadership, Engineering Leadership, and functional team leaders. The Technical Delivery Manager focuses on execution, delivery predictability, reporting, risk management, and release readiness. This position requires a strong technical background and the ability to participate effectively in discussions involving software architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and system dependencies. Responsibilities Agile Delivery Management Facilitate Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Tech Grooming, and Sprint Retrospectives across multiple technical teams. Ensure Scrum processes are consistently followed and continuously improved. Monitor sprint execution and team progress throughout each sprint. Track sprint commitments and completion rates. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve delivery predictability and team effectiveness. Sprint Reporting Produce sprint-level reporting including: Sprint progress and completion status Sprint Burn Down metrics Sprint commitment versus completion Team velocity trends Carry-over work Blocked work items Delivery risks and mitigation plans Release Readiness Track work across the following categories: Features Enablers Bugs Provide reporting on: Work item counts Story points Completed work Remaining work Team allocation by work type Epic Reporting Produce Epic status reporting including: Epic Burn Up metrics Epic completion percentage Remaining story points Forecast completion dates Dependency status Risk assessment At-risk and off-track initiatives Maintain visibility into delivery progress across all active Epics and strategic initiatives. Risk and Dependency Management Identify delivery risks early and proactively drive mitigation plans. Track and manage cross-team dependencies. Coordinate resolution of blockers impacting sprint, epic, or release commitments. Escalate issues that threaten delivery timelines or business objectives. Partner with functional leaders to remove obstacles and maintain execution momentum. Release Management Maintain visibility into all work planned for upcoming releases. Coordinate release readiness activities across teams. Track Features, Enablers, and Bugs included in each release. Maintain release dashboards and release status reports. Ensure release planning aligns with company Semantic Versioning (SemVer) standards. Communicate release readiness, risks, and forecasted release dates to stakeholders. Track release scope changes and impacts throughout the development lifecycle. Executive and Leadership Reporting Provide regular reporting to Product & Engineering Leadership including: Delivery forecasts Velocity trends Risk assessments Dependency tracking Team allocation across Features, Enablers, and Bugs Serve as a trusted source of delivery intelligence for leadership decision-making. Technical Environment The Technical Delivery Manager will work closely with teams building and operating solutions using: TypeScript React / Expo AWS Lambda Amazon API Gateway Amazon DynamoDB Serverless architectures JSON APIs CI/CD pipelines Cloud-native application development The successful candidate is not expected to contribute production code but must be able to understand technical discussions, identify technical dependencies, and assess delivery risks across these technologies. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in software engineering, technical program management, technical project management, delivery management, or related technical leadership roles. 3+ years of experience facilitating Agile and Scrum processes for software development teams. Strong understanding of software delivery lifecycles and release management. Experience working with engineering teams building cloud-native applications. Experience using Jira or similar Agile project management platforms. Strong analytical, reporting, and organizational skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Technical Requirements Candidates Must Be Able To Understand software architecture and system dependencies. Participate effectively in technical planning discussions. Understand APIs, cloud services, data flows, and integration points. Assess delivery risks associated with technical implementations. Communicate effectively with engineers, technical leads, and executive leadership. Understand release planning and Semantic Versioning (SemVer) concepts. Nice-to-Haves Previous experience as a Technical Project Manager, or Technical Program Manager. Experience supporting SaaS platforms. Experience with serverless architectures on AWS. Experience working with distributed engineering teams. Familiarity with data engineering, analytics platforms, or acquisition pipelines. Scrum, Agile, PMP, or related certifications. Success Metrics Success In This Role Will Be Measured By Sprint predictability Epic delivery predictability Release predictability Accuracy and timeliness of reporting Blocker resolution effectiveness Dependency management effectiveness Reduction in delivery surprises Stakeholder confidence in delivery visibility Continuous improvement in Agile delivery processes The ideal candidate combines the technical credibility of a former engineer with the organizational discipline of a delivery leader, enabling teams to execute effectively while providing leadership with clear and actionable insight into delivery progress. Compensation: Salary range for this role is $3,000- $ 3,500 per month, based on experience. Benefits OneClick Code offers generous PTO and 9 paid US company holidays. We provide a reimbursement program to help offset private health insurance expenses. Employees are eligible for up to $125 USD per month in reimbursements for qualifying private health insurance costs. Location: Remote

title: Technical Product Owner
description: About Pasito Pasito is the AI workspace for employee benefits. We’re rethinking how group insurance and benefits are underwritten, delivered, used and measured - by the people who design them and the people who depend on them. Instead of static PDFs, disconnected systems, and manual workflows, Pasito brings plan design, payroll and benefits data, claims, and financial context into a single, AI‑native workspace that helps benefits actually work for the 178 million Americans who depend on this system. We don’t build for brokers, carriers and employers - we build with them. That collaboration shows up in everything we ship: AI agents that extract and structure plan data, tools that turn complexity into clarity for employees, and workflows that save carriers and consultants hundreds of hours per case. Today, Pasito supports many of the largest insurance carriers and brokers in the U.S. We’re backed by Y Combinator and Core Innovation Capital, and we’re growing quickly. We ship fast, iterate relentlessly, and care deeply about building systems that are accurate, scalable, and human. If you’re excited to work alongside exceptional operators and engineers, and apply AI in a legacy industry where precision and trust matter, Pasito is the place for you. The Role We’re hiring a Product Owner to own and drive the development of key products at Pasito, including our broker and carrier enrollment workbench and AI Extractions and plan processing products. This role sits at the center of the company, bridging customer needs and technical execution. You will report to the VP of Product & Data and take full ownership of the product and feature lifecycle for your areas, from idea to launch and beyond. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is exceptionally organized, an excellent communicator, and excited to own execution end-to-end. What You’ll Do Own the full product lifecycle Take products and features from concept to launch and beyond Define requirements, write clear product specs, and manage execution through delivery Ensure high quality and usability before anything ships Drive day-to-day product execution Work closely with engineering, design, data, quality assurance, and forward-deployed teams to prioritize, scope, and ship features Maintain clear roadmaps and ensure timelines are met Identify tradeoffs quickly and keep development moving forward Bridge customer needs and product decisions Work closely with internal teams and clients to understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities Translate real-world use cases into clear product requirements Understand what users ask for and what they actually need, ensuring what we build solves meaningful problems Own communication and rollout Partner with Marketing to clearly communicate product updates and launches Create high-quality written materials (release notes, product docs, internal updates) Ensure messaging is clear, polished, and aligned with product value Enable internal teams Train forward-deployed, sales, and client teams on new features and workflows Create documentation and materials that make products easy to understand and use Act as the internal expert for your product areas Who You Are An exceptional communicator with outstanding written and spoken English Highly organized and detail-oriented, and skilled at multi-tasking Strong sense of ownership (you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks) Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment Low ego, highly collaborative, and focused on building great products Naturally curious about how systems work and how to improve them User-focused; you ground decisions in a genuine understanding of the people who will use our products Technical Experience We’re Excited About 2–5 years of experience in product, engineering or a similar role Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, design, or technical teams Strong experience writing clear, structured documentation or product specs Experience managing projects or workflows end-to-end Exposure to B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or complex workflows is a plus Interest in AI-driven products or data-heavy systems is a plus What’s In It For You Real ownership: You will directly own products used by leading brokers and carriers Central role: Sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and customers Fast growth: Learn quickly by owning meaningful product areas early in your career Strong team: Work closely with experienced leaders across Product, Engineering, Forward-Deployed, Marketing and Sales Impact: Your work will directly shape how benefits are delivered to millions of people Statement of Equal Opportunity Pasito is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe great teams are built through diversity of background, perspective, and experience, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Instead of static PDFs, disconnected systems, and manual workflows, Pasito brings plan design, payroll and benefits data, claims, and financial context into a single, AI‑native workspace that helps benefits actually work for the 178 million Americans who depend on this system. We don’t build for brokers, carriers and employers - we build with them. That collaboration shows up in everything we ship: AI agents that extract and structure plan data, tools that turn complexity into clarity for employees, and workflows that save carriers and consultants hundreds of hours per case. Today, Pasito supports many of the largest insurance carriers and brokers in the U.S. We’re backed by Y Combinator and Core Innovation Capital, and we’re growing quickly. We ship fast, iterate relentlessly, and care deeply about building systems that are accurate, scalable, and human. If you’re excited to work alongside exceptional operators and engineers, and apply AI in a legacy industry where precision and trust matter, Pasito is the place for you. This role sits at the center of the company, bridging customer needs and technical execution. title: Delivery Manager
description: Svitla Inc. is looking for a Delivery Manager with a background in technical development, infrastructure, or consulting to oversee the successful delivery of projects and services across LATAM. In this role, you'll manage multiple teams, ensure the successful execution of client projects — including supporting and following up on Svitlers' performance — and maintain high-quality delivery standards throughout. Location: LATAM (Remote, with flexibility) Employment Type: Full-time Requirements 4+ years of experience (for Senior DM) in project management or delivery management, with a focus on software development or consulting Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish. Experience with business requirements analysis. Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and other frameworks. Strong knowledge of development best practices. Experience working with distributed teams across various locations and time zones. Proven ability to manage key client projects and act as a main point of contact. Strong leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide teams. Experience conducting interviews and hiring developers. Solid understanding of software architecture and technical concepts. Exposure to all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). High self-motivation, with the ability to inspire and motivate others. Will be a plus Experience presenting at meetings. Knowledge of web, desktop, and mobile development. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Experience with business and/or requirements analysis. Strong understanding of the IT business landscape: product/solution development, consulting services, IT services, staffing, and projects. Experience with product implementations such as SAP, JD Edwards, Salesforce, or similar. Responsibilities Project & Service Coordination Lead and manage the coordination of 10–15 projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery. Work closely with clients to clarify and validate requirements across various projects. Team & People Management Oversee the ramp-up and onboarding process for new team members. Monitor team morale, satisfaction, and performance; resolve management issues to keep team dynamics healthy. Perform bi-monthly 1:1 meetings with resources allocated to your projects or country, logging outcomes in designated corporate tools (SvitlaID, Excel). Communicate end-of-project notices to Svitlers, together with HR, and support resource reallocation. Client & Stakeholder Communication Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Gather regular feedback from clients, teams, and developers to identify areas for improvement. Act as the main point of contact for accounts under your portfolio. Recruiting & Pipeline Management Evaluate new positions for existing clients, validating requirements, budget, best countries to screen, and contract terms provided by sales. Propose JD improvements to sales when needed. Evaluate candidates received from recruiting and ensure a strong, healthy pipeline for all assigned positions. Stay on top of all candidates sent to clients for review, and recommend screening adjustments if candidate quality doesn't meet expectations. Keep all stakeholders in the recruiting process informed of progress and key actions. Work with project coordinators to help candidates move through the pipeline. Reporting & Operations Provide regular reports on project progress, team performance, and any issues or risks. Control, verify, and approve monthly Svitlers' time reports (per contract terms). Report on position status during Svitla's weekly meetings. Trigger the notebook assignment/request process for new employees via the corporate ticketing tool. Business Development Identify new opportunities for collaboration and additional projects with existing clients. Alignment & Presence Follow company policies, processes, and guidelines. Attend the office 1–2 times per week for team meetings and collaboration (not mandatory), plus any Svitla-promoted meetings or events in your location. Operational KPIs Fill Rate (% of positions closed) Time to Fill Gross Profit per account Net Gains (hires – attrition) % Bench Reallocation (within 30 days) WE OFFER US and EU projects based on advanced technologies. Competitive compensation based on skills and experience. Comprehensive private medical insurance. Regular performance appraisals to support your growth. Flexibility in workspace, either remote, our welcoming office or local coworking. Bonuses for recommendations of new employees. Bonuses for article writing, public talks, other activities. 15 vacation days, 10 national holidays, 10 sick leaves. Personalized learning program tailored to your interests and skill development. Free tech webinars and meetups organized by Svitla. Fun corporate online\offline celebrations and activities. Well-established remote culture. Awesome team, friendly and supportive community!

solutions solve real problems.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to partner closely with engineering and design to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements and shipped solutions.</li><li>Strong product judgment, with the ability to make prioritization trade-offs using customer insights, business context, and data.</li><li>Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Customer Success Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. The Engagement Delivery Senior Manager collaborates with other leaders to ensure consistent delivery standard methodologies and influences the overall global engagement and delivery approach. They are responsible for meeting and exceeding business targets and providing leadership with accurate forecasts and metrics. They contribute to thought leadership and lead efforts to drive positive change, organizational initiatives, objectives and methods forward with executive-level engagement. They take ownership and personal responsibility for implementing change despite opposition or barriers and confidently make decisions in conditions of uncertainty. They are strong mentors who lead by example and embody the Salesforce values. Engagement Delivery Sr. Manager (Program Management Sr. Manager), could join into a diverse team for the following industry verticals: Commercial and Enterprise (Manufacturing, Auto, Energy, Travel, Transportation, Hospitality, and Business Services). Communications, Media, and Technology. Financial Services including the Insurance industry. Healthcare and Life Sciences. Retail Consumer Goods. Public Sector, Non-profit, and Education. Your Impact Lead programs by staying aligned on program scope, and release planning, as well as aligning one or more teams on vision, and business goals, creating the program structure, and securing cross-functional alignment. Drive teams through the Software engineering experience using Agile and demonstrated analytical and technical skills. Drive meetings with key team members for each program to help make key decisions, remove obstacles, and address key program issues. Be the key driver to ensure business goals are met and drive the strategic vision of each program. Develop strong partnerships with key functional team members to drive focus on business goals. Be a trusted partner for executive management to ensure program success. Partner with cross-functional teammates to drive workgroup alignment meetings to address tactical release issues, dependencies, team status, production issues, metrics review, etc. (cross-functional - Product Owners, Scrum Masters, TechOps, Release Eng, Capacity, Functional Managers, Release Management). Provide awareness of program status (issues, risks, metrics, etc.) on an ongoing basis through push status reporting. Handle "program/feature" dependencies across multiple teams, scrum teams, functions, divisions, and stakeholders. Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent teams from delivering on project goals. Provide monthly program reviews and updates at sprint reviews (give details into the current state of project goals, risks, and critical issues). Create a collaborative environment that fosters creativity, innovation, and learning. Operate as a catalyst within the organization to advance our Product & Technology strategy globally and drive team members across client organizations through change. Minimum Requirements 15+ years of experience (with 5+ years leading multiple work streams) in a program management role leading enterprise-scale CRM (or similar) projects. 10+ years experience with management consulting or consulting services. SFDC experience is not required but parallel implementation experience is required. Demonstrated project leadership skills with direct responsibility for running project teams, budgeting, and scheduling against a customer or vendor contract. Lead internal and external project customers; conflict management, issues, executive communication, and leadership skills. Outstanding and effective communication skills; along with good executive presence. Verbal and written; ability to work with remote teams during non-traditional business hours. Ability to lead enterprise-wide engagements, facilitate meetings with client executives, mentor teams of senior team members, and proactively run project risk ability to weigh business and technical requirements to identify dependencies, produce project plans and estimates. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented environment. Ability to multi-task and perform effectively. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration and/or Information Technology or equivalent experience. Agile SCRUM Master Certification. PMP Certification preferred. Salesforce.com Certifications (Admin, Sales, Service, Marketing, etc.) preferred. Preferred Qualifications Bring strategic and tactical enterprise software project delivery experience to Salesforce clients. Provide senior-level consulting and counsel to client business and technology executives as a trusted advisor. Build strong executive-client relationships to enable them to persuade and influence the direction of the delivery and resolve key issues; lead client customer concerns and resolve through experience and relationship/trust-building. Align multi-cloud delivery standard methodologies, resourcing, team structure, knowledge, and assets. Oversight and mentorship of project leadership and practitioners. Support Delivery Assurance and the dissemination of Salesforce’s delivery standards and practices across programs. Coaching and training recommendations for Project Managers. Define and lead program governance (controls). Allocate and supervise the budget and resources. Align the organization or strategic direction that impacts the individual components and the overall program goals and objectives. Create and lead project plans; supervise and review project progress and timelines; adjust schedules and plans as needed, and identify and resolve issues to ensure project success. Ensure on-time and on-budget delivery of large-scale programs while also ensuring that program gates and governance are properly adhered to during the execution of the project. Track utilization of project resources against the prioritization and budget. This includes on-time entry and approvals for project timesheets. Run routine execution of project implementations. Assist with the planning, tracking, documentation, and status updates for the project. Lead scope changes and ensures the project is delivered on time and within budget. Able to run enterprise-level programs consisting of 50+ person teams with multiple delivery workstreams (3+) and sophisticated integrations requiring multi-functional collaboration and management Exercise solid program leadership skills combined with a good eye for business and in-depth analytical skills. Find opportunities to demonstrate all Salesforce technologies. Participate in end-to-end implementation planning including program management, issue management, communication, and organizational change. Leverage business knowledge and expertise to drive business process improvements. Have difficult conversations regarding budget, resources, and timeline and formally collect and communicate outcomes of those meetings. Accountable for all project aspects, reviewing those results prepared by the team prior to submission to the client. Identify, lead and mitigate program risk. Possible travel of about 50%, but exact travel requirements will vary based on customer. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. Posting Statement Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Product Owner
description: Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a Senior Product Owner for a full-time position (40 hours per week) in Argentina. Our client offers a comprehensive suite of billing, payments, and software solutions for professional services firms. You'll drive the day-to-day product work behind Tabs3 and Orion, the practice management platforms that thousands of law firms rely on to run their business. It is a hands-on role that spans the full product lifecycle. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Mid-Market and Enterprise Legal Solutions, you will help define the roadmap and then own the details that turn it into shipped software: researching incoming feature requests, building the case for what to prioritize, writing product requirements documents and user stories, and partnering closely with engineering and design through delivery. When developers hit product or specification questions that block progress, you will work with customers, internal teams, and leadership to quickly determine the right direction and keep development moving. The role combines responsibilities that are often split across product management, product ownership, business analysis, and scrum master. It is well-suited to a candidate who has worked across several of these areas and is comfortable moving between them, weighing priorities with leadership one moment, and defining exactly how a feature should behave the next. Success in this role demands a self-directed professional who pursues the information needed to move work forward rather than waiting for it to arrive. Requirements 5+years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, software consulting, or solution design, with experience across more than one of these areas. Expertise in business analysis with the ability to break down complex problems, determine what to build and why, and define clear requirements. Expertise in writing of requirements: a track record of PRDs, specifications, and user stories with acceptance criteria that engineering teams readily accept. Exceptional communication skills, which are central to this role: be comfortable interviewing and talking with customers, presenting ideas and recommendations clearly to senior leadership, and working closely with engineering and design. Have a proactive, self-directed approach with the ability to actively seek out the information needed to move work forward rather than waiting for it. Be comfortable working with data to support prioritization and to make a defensible case for what to build. Strong critical thinking with the ability to ask the right questions and get to the root of a problem rather than settling for surface-level answers. Detail-oriented and well organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across two products. Working hours that overlap with U.S. Central and Eastern business hours, with Eastern time as the priority (overlap: 8 am till 5 pm EST). Nice To Have Experience with SaaS products, ideally professional services or practice management software. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and backlog management. A working understanding of how software is built, including APIs, databases, and integrations. Experience collaborating with UX/design teams on user experience and interface decisions. Experience supporting and evolving established, mature products alongside newer offerings. Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience), ideally in business, information technology, computer science, or a related field. Understanding of AI tools to work more efficiently (e.g., Claude, Figma AI, and similar). Responsibilities Gather and investigate incoming requests from customers, sales, support, and internal teams to understand the underlying problem behind each ask, not just the stated solution. Provide the data and context that drive prioritization decisions, customer impact, frequency, effort, and fit with product strategy, and present clear recommendations to leadership. Translate priorities into clear, thorough requirements that define what a feature does, how it behaves, and the edge cases that matter. Decompose features into well-scoped user stories with acceptance criteria that engineering can pick up and execute against. Work closely with the design team throughout the product lifecycle, providing direction and feedback on user experience and design solutions to ensure they align with product requirements. When developers raise product or specification questions, drive them to a fast resolution, pulling in customers, internal teams, and leadership as needed, so the team is never stuck waiting on a decision. Develop deep, end-to-end knowledge of each feature: the workflows, the data, and the customer’s reality, so the team builds the right thing the right way. Shepherd work through discovery, design, build, and release within an agile process, keeping the backlog healthy and work moving. Interview and understand customers, present ideas and recommendations clearly to the VP and other internal leaders, and maintain a strong, collaborative working relationship with the development team. Stay close to how legal professionals use Tabs3 and Orion, and let that understanding inform every product decision. WE OFFER US and EU projects based on advanced technologies. Competitive compensation based on skills and experience. Comprehensive private medical insurance. Regular performance appraisals to support your growth. Flexibility in workspace, either remote, our welcoming office or local coworking. Bonuses for recommendations of new employees. Bonuses for article writing, public talks, other activities. 15 vacation days, 10 national holidays, 10 sick leaves. Personalized learning program tailored to your interests and skill development. Free tech webinars and meetups organized by Svitla. Fun corporate online\offline celebrations and activities. Well-established remote culture. Awesome team, friendly and supportive community!

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Job Description About You You are a Service Delivery Manager with proven experience leading Managed Services engagements in regulated environments. You thrive building strong client relationships, driving transition governance, and coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver seamless service throughout the entire engagement lifecycle. You are confident communicating with executive stakeholders, managing scope, mitigating risks, and translating complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes. You excel in fast-paced environments where operational excellence, governance, and continuous improvement are key to successful service delivery. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience managing MSP or managed services engagements, specifically within financial services or regulated industries. Deep familiarity with US financial services regulatory frameworks (e.g., NYDFS Part 500, FFIEC, or equivalent standards). Strong command of end-to-end transition and onboarding methodologies across all phases (Discovery, Foundation Build, Hypercare, and Steady-State Cutover). Hands-on operational experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, Freshservice, and Jira. Executive presence with proven comfort presenting to and communicating with C-suite stakeholders. Strong scope management skills and the resilience to hold firm on boundaries under client pressure. Ability to translate technical topics effectively for non-technical stakeholders. Negotiation experience handling commercial change orders. Experience with Azure cloud engagements specifically (not just AWS/GCP), including direct engagement with the Microsoft partner ecosystem (e.g., Azure Expert MSP, CSP model) (Nice to have). Relevant industry certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL Foundation, or ITIL Managing Professional (Nice to have). Familiarity with AI tools to improve operational efficiency and delivery workflows. Professional English proficiency (written and spoken). You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Act as the named relationship owner and central point of contact from Day 1 of the transition lifecycle. Own the transition governance cadence, driving formal sign-offs for phase deliverables across the entire onboarding journey. Coordinate and facilitate knowledge-transfer sessions across cross-functional stakeholders (infrastructure, security, application, and data platform teams). Run weekly phase-gate reviews, manage escalation resolution, and lead Hypercare exit sign-offs with the client’s designated service owner. Hold firm on agreed scope boundaries under client pressure while maintaining complete ownership of overall account success. Exercise sound judgment to surface risks and escalate issues internally before formal commitments are made to the client. Lead discussions around commercial change orders and negotiate adjustments as project scope evolves. Bridge the communication gap by translating complex technical updates into clear insights for business and non-technical client stakeholders. Leverage ITSM tools to track operational performance, maintain governance standards, and drive continuous delivery improvement. Leverage AI tools to improve operational efficiency, synthesize information, generate delivery summaries, and streamline communication workflows. Qualifications Experience as a Service Delivery Manager, Transition Manager, or Account Manager leading Managed Services engagements. Experience managing end-to-end transition and onboarding processes. Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, Freshservice, or Jira. Strong stakeholder, governance, and commercial management experience. Professional English proficiency. Additional Information All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . title: Product Manager
description: About Lazo Lazo is the U.S. back-office platform for founders — an AI-native operating system that unifies incorporation, tax, bookkeeping, legal, payroll, and fundraising. We serve a growing base of recurring customers and we're building the layer that lets a founder run a company with a fraction of the operational overhead it takes today. We're not "a SaaS with an AI feature." Our product is a set of specialized agents doing real professional-services work, with experts in the loop. That's what you'd be building. The Role We're hiring a Product Manager from problem discovery with real users and internal experts, through spec, delivery, and post-release measurement. This is a hands-on IC role. You won't manage people. You will own outcomes: you'll sit with the squad, write the spec, defend the acceptance criteria, test the thing before it ships, and come back with the numbers afterward. Reports to: Head of Product & Engineering Works daily with: engineering squads, external clients and internal client teams (tax, bookkeeping, legal, CS) who are the operators using what you build Location: Remote (Americas time zones) What you'll ownDiscovery Run continuous discovery: interviews with founders, shadowing internal operators, watching real workflows end to end. Turn what you find into sharp problem statements — sized, with a hypothesis, not a wishlist. Bring the "why now" and the trade-off, not just the ask. Specs & delivery Write specs in our SDP format: Outcome → Behavior → Acceptance . If the acceptance criteria aren't testable, the spec isn't done. Negotiate and sign the Convenio with your internal client team — the versioned pact that defines scope, limits, responsibilities, and success criteria before we build. You'd own it for your surfaces. Work inside the squad's cadence: grooming, prioritization, unblocking, and QA. You test before your users do. Cut scope out loud. Say what's not in the release and why. Measurement Instrument your own funnels. Activation, adoption, retention, time-to-value for the surfaces you own. For AI/agent features: define quality and accuracy thresholds, build the eval set, track drift, and know when a human needs to be in the loop. Bring numbers to weekly review. Kill things that don't move. Feedback loops Own the voice-of-customer channels for your area: in-product feedback, CS escalations, beta cohorts. Close the loop publicly — release notes, changelog, what shipped and what didn't. Experiments Design and run PLG experiments on onboarding, self-serve activation, and packaging for your surfaces. Full ownership of the experiment: hypothesis, instrumentation, readout, decision. Must-haves 3–5+ years in Product Management in B2B SaaS, owning a surface end to end. No people-management experience required. Track record of writing specs engineers can build from without translation. Comfortable with product analytics: events, funnels, cohorts. You can pull your own data and don't wait for someone to build you a dashboard. You've run real experiments — not just shipped features and hoped. You work well with domain experts who know more than you about their domain, and you can extract a workflow from someone who's never described it before. Professional English and Spanish , written and spoken. You use AI tools daily as part of how you work, not as a novelty. Nice to have Operations-heavy or compliance-centric domains: finance, tax, payroll, legal, accounting. Experience shipping AI/LLM features to production, with real quality metrics and human-in-the-loop design. Technical enough to read a schema, follow an API contract, and write a decent Gherkin scenario. Familiarity with EOS-style operating rhythms (Rocks, weekly scorecard) and Monday-based delivery tracking. How we work Ownership, speed, clarity, relentless improvement. We communicate directly, we measure what matters, and we sign our work with pride. We're small and moving fast toward hard deadlines with real consequences — tax seasons don't move. That means high autonomy and high accountability in the same breath. Benefits. 💰 Compensation in USD. 🧑‍💻 #Flexible work culture - we focus on goal achievement! 📍 100% remote. 🏖️ 3 weeks of vacation. 🧑‍🎄 Week off between Christmas and New Year's Eve. 💆 Health benefits. 🎂 Birthday day off. 👪 Marriage leave, maternity/paternity/adoption leave. And it gets better: 🚀 Develop in a fast-paced and challenging environment. ⭐ Be part of a highly committed team with an excellent work environment. 🌎 Work for one of the most challenging ecosystems: the United States. Lazo, we provide peace of mind to fast-growing startups by ensuring all financial, accounting, tax, and legal needs are being met while they focus on product and traction. We provide information in a timely manner, ready to be shared with investors, ensuring the startup is always investment-ready.

title: Product Manager
description: <p><strong><u>About Corva</u></strong></p><p>Corva has built a first-of-its-kind energy app store on a bedrock of best-in-class technologies, data pipelines, and a secure and scalable architecture. Our energy solutions solve today's toughest well delivery challenges, from well design through drillout. The ever-evolving platform is not only future-proof for digitizing operations but is your toolkit to accelerate sustainability and energy transition goals. Our platform is built for speed and reliability and delivers unmatched features and capabilities.</p><p><br></p><p>Corva is powering worldwide innovation by driving efficiency, productivity, and profitability with our innovative energy solutions.</p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>Mission</u></strong></p><p><em>Corva’s mission is to accelerate the future of energy.</em></p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>Values</u></strong></p><p><em>Boldness - Bias Action - Full Transparency - Extreme Ownership - Radical Candor</em></p><p><em>Rapid Iteration - Uncompromising Quality - High Agency</em></p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>About the Role</u></strong></p><p>Are you passionate about driving innovation in cutting-edge software products? Do you have a deep understanding of data analytics, product development, and real-time systems? Are you looking to contribute to the growth of a high-impact platform within a fast-paced startup environment?</p><p><br></p><p>Corva is at the forefront of real-time data and analytics in the oil &amp; gas industry, empowering some of the world's largest companies to optimize critical operations 24/7. </p><p><br></p><p>As a Product Manager at Corva, you’ll lead a product team focused on delivering high-impact solutions across the oil and gas domain. This may include short-term customer-driven initiatives, longer-term strategic projects, and internally prioritized improvements that strengthen Corva’s platform, workflows, and real-time operational capabilities.</p><p>In this role, you will be responsible for guiding products from conception through release, working closely with engineering, data science, and UX teams to deliver products that are not only functional but also technically sophisticated. This is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong technical background to manage product development in a highly dynamic and data-driven environment.</p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>What You'll Do</u></strong></p><ul><li><u>End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management</u>: Own the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and technical specification to development, release, and iteration.</li><li><u>Technical Roadmap Development</u>: Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to define detailed product roadmaps, balancing innovative features with technical feasibility and business priorities.</li><li><u>Data-Driven Product Decisions</u>: Analyze product performance using real-time data insights and platform analytics to drive product refinements and feature optimizations.</li><li><u>Customer-Centric Innovation</u>: Conduct detailed customer research and interviews, translating industry needs into technically detailed requirements, user stories, and product features.</li><li><u>Wireframing &amp; Prototyping</u>: Work with UI/UX designers to create wireframes, prototypes, and flow diagrams to clearly communicate new product concepts to engineering teams.</li><li><u>Cross-Functional Collaboration</u>: Serve as a technical liaison between engineering, data science, and business teams, ensuring product requirements are fully understood and executed effectively.</li><li><u>Feature Prioritization</u>: Lead sprint planning and backlog grooming, ensuring high-impact features and technical upgrades are prioritized and delivered on schedule.</li><li><u>Stakeholder Communication</u>: Prepare detailed technical reports and documentation for both internal stakeholders and external partners, including status updates, progress reports, and risk assessments.</li><li><u>Technical Feasibility Assessments</u>: Work closely with software engineers to assess technical constraints and explore solutions that align with both customer needs and platform capabilities.</li><li><u>Market &amp; Competitive Analysis</u>: Stay informed about the latest trends in upstream oil &amp; gas technology, data analytics, and real-time systems, using these insights to shape product development.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong><u>Qualifications</u></strong></p><ul><li><u>Experience in Software Development</u>: Experience developing, releasing, iterating and utilizing software. </li><li><u>Technical Expertise</u>: Strong understanding of software development processes, real-time data systems, and cloud-based platform technologies.</li><li><u>Proven Experience in Product Management</u>: 2+ years of product management experience in a technical field, with a focus on data analytics, enterprise software, or real-time platforms.</li><li><u>Analytical &amp; Problem-Solving Skills</u>: Ability to break down complex technical problems and create actionable product solutions using data-driven insights.</li><li><u>Wireframing &amp; Prototyping</u>: Proficiency with wireframing tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch) to create user flows, product wireframes, and prototypes.</li><li><u>Cross-Functional Leadership</u>: Demonstrated ability to lead and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including software engineers, data scientists, and UX/UI designers.</li><li><u>Strong Communication Skills</u>: Ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner. <u>Fluent in English and Spanish.</u></li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong><u>Preferred Qualifications</u></strong></p><ul><li><u>Experience with Data Analytics Platforms</u>: Experience managing products related to real-time data processing, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise-scale data solutions.</li><li><u>Familiarity with Cloud Technologies</u>: Knowledge of cloud-based platforms (e.g., AWS) and scalable data solutions.</li><li><u>Bachelor’s Degree in a Technical Field</u>: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical discipline.</li><li><u>Field Engineering Experience</u>: Direct experience with Drilling Operations close to the action.</li><li><u>RTOC Experience</u>: Experience working in Remote Command centers focusing on Directional Drilling, Performance Optimization and Hazard Avoidance</li></ul><p><br></p>

Our partner is looking for a Product Manager, Self Managed Service based in Argentina. We are looking for a Product Manager to drive the strategy and evolution of a self-managed enterprise platform used by organizations worldwide. You will own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for how customers deploy, configure, and operate complex solutions in their own environments. The role combines product strategy, customer insight, and close collaboration with engineering, marketing, customer success, and field teams. You will help simplify enterprise deployments across cloud-native, on-premises, and highly regulated environments while improving customer adoption and satisfaction. This is an opportunity to shape a critical product area, influence innovation, and contribute to the future of intelligent business process orchestration. You will work in a remote and flexible environment where your decisions have a direct impact on customers and the broader product strategy. Accountabilities As a Product Manager, Self Managed Service, you will be responsible for defining the direction of the product area, ensuring customer needs are translated into impactful solutions, and enabling teams to deliver scalable enterprise capabilities. Define and drive the market-focused vision, strategy, and product requirements for the self-managed product portfolio. Own and prioritize the product roadmap, balancing customer needs, business objectives, technical opportunities, and market trends. Gather, analyze, and manage feedback from customers, partners, communities, and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement. Work closely with engineering teams to define priorities, prepare impactful initiatives, and ensure delivery of valuable product capabilities. Improve the customer experience by reducing deployment complexity and enabling reliable adoption across different enterprise environments. Strong understanding of enterprise software development, deployment models, and infrastructure concepts. Experience working with customers in complex industries such as banking, financial services, insurance, or other regulated sectors. Ability to translate customer feedback and market insights into clear product strategies and priorities. Strong collaboration skills with engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, and technical teams. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, global environment. Willingness and ability to use and understand the product you are responsible for. title: Technical Service Delivery Manager
description: About Motivus At Motivus, we believe in unlocking human potential through innovative, cutting-edge solutions. With over 1,600 team members across 5 countries, we provide a full spectrum of software and digital services. Our teams are dedicated to driving sustainability, pushing the boundaries of technology, and building the next generation of world-class digital solutions that empower our clients and make a lasting impact. As part of our team, you'll work alongside forward-thinking professionals committed to creating groundbreaking solutions that shape the future of the industry Position Overview We are looking for a highly skilled and technically credible Senior Service Delivery Manager to join our Global Delivery Organization. This is not a traditional management role — we need someone who earns the respect of SDA and SysAdmin agents by truly understanding their domain, not just overseeing it. In this role, you will lead a team of junior technical agents, own SLA/KPI performance with real contractual accountability, and serve as the primary client contact for all service delivery and technical escalation matters. You will operate at the intersection of ITIL-based service management, DevOps/CI/CD environments, and people development — driving both operational excellence and team growth. General Information L evel: Senior level — 6+ years of combined experience in IT Service Management and technical supportroles . Modality: Remote. Availability for on-call rotations and off-hours support during critical incidents or deployments . Availab i lity: Full time Language: English (advanced) + Spanish (advanced). Academic Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. Equivalent experience accepted when combined with demonstrable technical depth and career progression. Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation certified (required). ITIL 4 Managing Professional strongly preferred. Key Responsibilties Team Leadership & Technical Coaching Directly lead, coach, and develop a team of Junior Application Support Agents (SDA and SysAdmin profiles) in day-to-day service delivery. Act as the technical reference point for the team: validate escalation decisions, guide triage logic, and close knowledge gaps in real time. Run daily standups, ticket queue reviews, and structured 1:1s; design individual development plans aligned to each agent's technical track. Set clear expectations, deliver real-time feedback, and be present — visibly and actively — during critical shifts and major incidents. Incident & Problem Management Own the end-to-end Incident Management lifecycle: lead P1/P2 bridges, coordinate resolution, and drive stakeholder communication. Validate and challenge agent-level diagnostics; ensure root cause analysis goes deep enough before incidents are closed. Drive a proactive Problem Management culture: identify recurring technical failure patterns, manage the KEDB, and lead structured remediation. Define and maintain incident response playbooks, escalation trees, and triage checklists for DevOps, Build, and SysAdmin support domains. SDLC & Technical Operations Oversight Liaise with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure support agents have the context needed to triage effectively in CI/CD and build environments. Identify gaps between agent technical capability and the team's support scope; drive training, documentation, and knowledge transferinitiatives. Champion automation and tooling improvements that reduce manual effort and ticket volume across the team. SLA Performance & Continuous Improvment Own SLA/KPI accountability for the account; monitor in-period performance and take corrective action before breaches occur. Design and execute Get-to-Green (GtG) plans when service performance falls below contractual targets. Benchmark team performance quarter-over-quarter; present improvement trends to clients and leadership with data and narrative. Client Relationship & Reporting Serve as the primary point of contact for the client on all service delivery and technical escalation matters. Lead service review meetings and QBRs; deliver SLA/KPI reports that translate technical outcomes into business language. Proactively communicate risks, trends, and improvements — before the client has to ask. Identify opportunities for account improvement and communicate them to internal leadership. Required Experience 6+ years in IT roles combining service delivery, technical support, or software/systems operations. 3+ years in a Service Delivery Manager, Technical Lead, or equivalent people-management role with direct reports. Hands-on background in at least one of the technical domains managed by the team: DevOps/CI/CD pipelines, Linux SysAdmin, C/C++ build systems, or application debugging. Demonstrated experience leading and coaching junior technical agents (SDA/SysAdmin profile) in a managed services or software support environment. Proven accountability for SLA/KPI performance in production environments with real contractual obligations. Experience operating within SDLC-adjacent support functions: release cycles, build pipelines, and environment management. MSP, outsourcing, or multi-client delivery experience is a strong advantage. Technical Knowledge Required ITIL v4 Framework: deep working knowledge of Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management — applied daily, not just theoretical. Incident Management: leads P1/P2 bridges autonomously; enforces correct classification, escalation, and documentation; tracks incident trends. Problem Management: conducts formal RCA sessions; manages the KEDB; drives measurable reduction of recurring technical incidents. SLA Management: in-period monitoring to anticipate and prevent breaches; accountable for contractual outcomes; designs and executes GtG plans. ITSM Tooling: advanced proficiency in ServiceNow, JIRA Service Management, or equivalent; configures queues, SLA rules, dashboards, and audit-ready reports. SDLC Awareness: understands the Software Development Lifecycle from requirements through deployment and production support. Linux & OS Fundamentals: comfortable navigating Linux environments; understands OS-level concepts relevant to SDA and SysAdmin agents. CI/CD & DevOps Concepts: knowledgeable in CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git/SCM), and deployment processes; can interpret pipeline failures. Build Systems: familiar with C/C++ build concepts, Make, gcc/clang, and common build errors; able to coach agents and validate escalation decisions. Scripting Literacy: reads and interprets scripts in Python, Bash, Perl, or JavaScript; can validate agent-proposed fixes without writing production code independently. Debugging & Monitoring: understands debugging tools (gdb, pdb, IDE-based debuggers) and monitoring platforms; reviews agent diagnostics. Service Reporting: designs and delivers weekly/monthly/quarterly SLA/KPI reports; translates technical data into clear operational narratives. Nice to Have Familiarity with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and their integration into developer support workflows. Knowledge of ASAN/Valgrind, GCOV, or similar profiling and code quality tools. Cloud platform fundamentals (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at an operational support level. Why Join Us? Grow Your Career: At Motivus, you will have the opportunity to expand your skills and take on leadership roles in diverse projects. Work on Emerging Tech: Be at the forefront of innovation by working with cutting-edge tech nologies and methodologies. Collaborative Environment: Work with talented teams that value your ideas and contributions . Learning and Development: We offer a range of L&D programs to help you advance your career. Client-Centric Approach: Contribute to solutions that create lasting value for global Fortune 500 clients. Our Values Culture of Innovation: We pursue innovation relentlessly, encouraging our teams to explore new ideas and technologies. Responsibility: We give back to the communities that support us and our clients . Learning & Development: Our employees lead, learn, and grow, supporting themselves and our clients.

title: Senior Product Manager, Payroll
description: Who We Are Is What We Do. Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers. Why should you be part of our success story? As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are. Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google. Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work. Summary As a Senior Product Manager, you will own and influence the product strategy, roadmap and GTM. You’ll collaborate with senior leaders, designers, engineers and subject-matter experts across the organization to ensure the fast delivery of the best-in-class experience to a global customer base. Responsibilities Building a clear vision, strategy, and execution path for your area of responsibility Working cross-functionally to collect and address the diverse needs of different product lines Leveraging all of the core PM skills you have honed to date to drive progress through the entire product development lifecycle. Collaborating with a team of highly talented product designers, engineers and product experts to execute your vision and deliver exceptional results. Balancing core product development with high-priority client escalations in a high-speed, remote-first working environment. Qualifications Minimum 5 years of product management experience in a fast pace environment (ideally scaleup/start-up) Independent and autonomous leader Understanding of both UX and UI Total Rewards Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission. Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion. Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location. We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it. Some things you'll enjoy Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page . Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations. This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy. For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT
