title: Senior Product Manager, Code
description: Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. We're looking for an experienced Product Manager to own how people extend Webflow with code, whether they're developers writing it themselves or the AI agents increasingly writing it alongside them. Our Code team builds the surfaces that bring code-based primitives into Webflow and keep them in sync with the rest of the platform. This is where Webflow's visual canvas meets real code. It's one of the hardest and most interesting seams in the product, connecting a visual way of building to the code underneath it so that neither one holds the other back. You'll own that seam, deciding how far the two worlds reach into each other and making the connection feel native to developers and agents. About The Role Location: Remote-first (Argentina) Full-time Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position) Application Information: Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled This posting is for a new position Reporting to the Director of Product Management, Develop As a Senior Product Manager, Code, you’ll … Build for developers and AI agents alike. You'll design surfaces that serve the developers who have always worked in code and the AI agents that increasingly write it, treating both as first-class users. Own the roadmap and delivery across the Code surfaces. You'll lead the products that let developers and agents extend Webflow with code, starting with code components, in close partnership with Engineering, Design, and Data. Define what "good" means for extensibility. You'll set the quality bar for developer-grade extensibility, including the hard problem of keeping a visual product and real code faithful to each other as each side changes. Make it all work as one. Several of these surfaces grew up separately. Sequence the work so the pieces reinforce each other and build shared primitives once, rather than solving the same problem twice. Contribute heavily to strategy, then ship it. You'll help shape where the area goes and turn that into a roadmap you deliver against, working as a partner rather than waiting to be handed direction. Get into the code. This is a hands-on role. You'll prototype, read and reason about code, and stay close enough to the implementation to make sharp technical calls. Place durable bets in a shifting landscape. Developer tooling and AI-assisted coding are moving fast, and you'll make choices that hold up as the tools and the ecosystem evolve. Requirements About you: BA/BS degree or equivalent experience Business-level fluency to read, write and speak in English You’ll thrive as a a Senior Product Manager, Code, if you: Have 5+ years of product management experience, with real depth in developer or platform products. Experience with APIs, extensibility, or developer tooling. Are genuinely technical. You read and reason about code, hold a point of view on API and abstraction design, and are comfortable working in a codebase rather than just adjacent to one. Relate to your users and hold more than one perspective at once. You have real empathy for the people you build for and can see a problem through several sets of eyes, balancing needs that pull in different directions without losing sight of any of them. Enjoy the full craft of building software. You're curious about every part of how products get made and like getting into the details wherever the work needs you, whether that's leading a user interview, prototyping an idea, writing a query to pin down a metric, or writing a sharp brief. Work as a peer and a thought partner. You shape direction alongside your manager and then run with it independently, at home in a player-coach partnership rather than a top-down chain of command. Stay curious, building fluency in emerging AI and developer tooling to speed up both your own work and your team's. Genuinely enjoy helping people build. You like being close to the developers and teammates you serve, and helping someone ship something they couldn't before is the part of the job that keeps it fun. Our Core Behaviors Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first. Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act. Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible. Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers. Benefits Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company. Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums. Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions. Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired. Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching. Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts. Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program. Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment. Remote, together At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Stay connected Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor. Please Note We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered. To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment. If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes. For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice .

description: <p><strong>About AppDirect</strong></p><p>Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture - one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.</p><p><strong>About Tackle, an AppDirect business unit</strong></p><p>Tackle, a business unit of AppDirect, is the leading solution built to help software companies generate revenue through data-driven Cloud go-to-market (Cloud GTM). Our platform and team help customers identify the right buyers, grow cloud co-sell relationships, and transact efficiently at scale through AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft. Tackle serves more than 500 software companies—including CrowdStrike, HashiCorp, New Relic, and Snyk—from high-growth startups to the largest software companies in the world.</p><p><strong>About You</strong></p><p><span>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong> to join our Product team and own critical product capabilities on both Tackle Platform and Salesforce app integration, such as co-sell and benefits.  This role sits at the heart of powering cloud go-to-market journeys for some of the largest technology companies in the world. </span><span>You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, and customer-facing teams to define a clear product vision, prioritize high-impact initiatives, and deliver solutions that make our platform more scalable, reliable, and valuable for customers. This role is critical to how we work with cloud partners and hyperscalers to drive customer value and revenue growth. </span><span>We’re especially excited about candidates who understand how to build products that integrate with cloud APIs, support co-sell motions, and can help us scale systems and processes as the business grows.</span></p><p><span><strong>What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact</strong></span></p><ul><li><span>Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for our Co-sell &amp; Benefits area.</span></li><li><span>Build and ship customer-facing products and experiences that help customers access and realize value from our partner and cloud ecosystem.</span></li><li><span>Work directly with customers, internal stakeholders, and partners to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and unmet needs, and translate them into clear product requirements.</span></li><li><span>Partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver features and improvements.</span></li><li><span>Use qualitative and quantitative data to prioritize work, define success metrics, and measure impact.</span></li><li><span>Balance short-term customer and business needs with long-term platform scalability and health.</span></li><li><span>Clearly communicate plans, progress, and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, producing concise, actionable product artifacts. </span></li><li><span>Produce concise, actionable product artifacts, including requirements, prioritization rationale, and launch plans.<br></span></li></ul><p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p><ul><li><span>Domain experience in B2B SaaS.</span></li><li><span>6+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record of owning and shipping customer-facing products.</span></li><li><span>Experience working with hyperscalers and cloud ecosystems. </span></li><li><span>Experience working with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback, validate assumptions, and ensure solutions solve real problems.</span></li><li><span>Demonstrated ability to partner closely with engineering and design to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements and shipped solutions.</span></li><li><span>Strong product judgment, with the ability to make prioritization trade-offs using customer insights, business context, and data.</span></li><li><span>Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain product decisions, trade-offs, and progress to both technical and non-technical audiences.</span></li><li><span>Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving execution in a fast-moving environment. </span></li><li><span>Have experience working with hyperscalers or cloud ecosystems. </span></li><li><span>Experience working with or building products on Salesforce (Nice to have).</span></li></ul><p> </p><p>(*) Interested candidates should submit their resume in English. Please note that Spanish versions will not be reviewed.</p><p>The position offers a flexible hybrid schedule: you will work one day per week onsite and four days remote. Compensation includes 15 paid working days (PTO) plus local holidays, comprehensive medical coverage (OSDE Plan 310) for you and your dependents, reimbursement for eligible wellness activities, English lessons, global and local events participation, and much more! </p><p> </p><p><em>At AppDirect, we believe that innovation thrives in an environment that houses diversity of excellence, experience and thought. We respect each AppDirector as their own fingerprint; unique with no one alike. We foster an environment of inclusion without regard to race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity enabling AppDirectors to embrace their uniqueness to do their best work. As such, we strongly encourage applications from Indigenous peoples, racialized people, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and/or people with intersectional identities.</em></p><p><em>At AppDirect we take privacy very seriously. For more information about our</em><em> </em><em>use and handling of personal data from job applicants, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information of our general privacy practices, please see AppDirect Privacy Notice:</em><em> </em></p><p><em>https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice</em></p><p><em>At AppDirect, AI tools may assist our recruitment team with administrative automations — always under human oversight. AI tools do not make hiring decisions or solely automated decisions about your candidacy – all decisions are made by our people. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your information may be processed in this way. You may request access or deletion at any time by contacting privacy@appdirect.com.</em></p><p></p><p></p>

title: Solution Delivery Manager - EY Global Delivery Services
location: Buenos Aires, Provincia de Buenos Aires, Argentina
description: <strong>Job Summary:<br><br></strong>The Solution Delivery Manager (SDM) plays an integral and wide-ranging role in the delivery of technology projects and programs across the Risk Management/SQM/GCO portfolio. The SDM focuses on delivering programs and projects in support of (but not always limited to) products used by our CBS teams to run and deliver our business. The SDM is a Product Owner and technical expert in the technologies which support their particular function.<br><br><strong>Essential Functions of the Job:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Understand the relevant functional area of Service Quality Management (SQM), gained through a combination of program delivery/implementation and support.</li><li>Manage the delivery of IT projects, budgets, forecast and strategic roadmaps.</li><li>Manage stakeholders across the CBS and service line landscape regarding SQM initiatives, with a particular focus on development of core software in support of the business, technical integration, and vendor implementations</li><li>Collaborate with leaders across EY Technology and CBS in delivery of the tooling to support the internal SQM processes.</li><li>Ensure ongoing awareness of the impact of future programs across the functional area and provide input to impact assessment as required.</li><li>Participate in product road mapping in support of business changes over a rolling three-to-five-year period in support of annual budgeting and requests for BAU and investment initiatives.</li><li>Make informed judgements and take appropriate action regarding issues which may potentially impact the quality of services delivered by the SQM delivery team, across relevant functional areas.</li><li>Analyze requirements from the business to understand the business processes supported, working closely with the project teams (program/project/product manager, technical lead, business analyst) and ensure on-time, on-budget, delivery to meet the functional requirements set forth by the business product owner.</li><li>Understanding the business processes, partner with the functional product owner to deliver on effective and efficient solutions in support of their processes.</li><li>Analyze service performance in delivery and operational support of the tool, using data provided from development through to incident reporting to determine quality of delivery and validate this against perception of the service.</li><li>Work closely with the operational support manager and team to ensure timely resolution to business critical issues.</li><li>Direct vendor management including enforcing SLA’s and contract negotiation.</li><li>Determine when it is appropriate to escalate and use judgement and experience to determine the most effective course of action.</li><li>Engage and collaborate with all stakeholders across the business and ET teams, using personal experience and judgement to define tailored approaches to dealing with specific stakeholders, setting expectations appropriately and building trust and confidence.</li><li>Ability and flexibility to work in a virtual environment across multiple time zones.</li><li>Domestic and international travel may be needed.</li><li>English is required, additional languages a plus.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Analytic/Decision-Making Responsibilities:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Monitor and manage program baseline to ensure activities are occurring as planned – scope, budget, and schedule – managing variances.</li><li>Working with the project team, proactively identify risks and issues on program – leading team to develop risk management and issue management plans.</li><li>Identify potential points of contention for missed deliverables, create and implement a strategy to mitigate shortfalls in timelines and budget.</li><li>Anticipate problems before they occur, define the problem or risk; identify possible causes; work with team to identify solutions; select and implement the most appropriate solution.</li><li>Develop and manage plans to address program strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.</li><li>Ability to balance both the “science” of how to perform project management and the “art” of program management.</li><li>Analytical skills and problem-solving skills needed to manage multiple factors on a program simultaneously.</li><li>Demonstrate business analytics to manage and meet sponsor and customer needs.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Knowledge and Skills Requirements:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Manage demanding customers and challenging suppliers fairly and effectively.</li><li>Manage service delivery performance and compliance through agreed metrics and service levels.</li><li>Commercially astute with strong negotiation and management skills.</li><li>Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively across a complex and diverse group of stakeholders and a multi-location development team.</li><li>Key understanding of technology and tools utilized for technology delivery.</li><li>Experience across packaged and bespoke systems and infrastructure, ideally on an international basis.</li><li>Track record of customer focus, based on openness, trust, and delivering on promises.</li><li>Extensive delivery experience that includes the use of supplier and off-shore resources.</li><li>Experience in managing contracts, ensuring clients and suppliers alike perform in accordance with original agreement.</li><li>Management skills to manage one or more large, complex projects simultaneously.</li><li>IT background with experience across the systems development life cycle with experience in all project phases – plan, initiate, elaborate, design, build, test, implement.</li><li>Knowledge and use of industry-standard project methods, tools and techniques. E.g. RAIDS, budget, communication, AGILE methodology, Azure Dev-ops.</li><li>Excellent written skills.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Supervision Responsibilities:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Service Delivery Manager leads project teams consisting of cross functional, global, and virtual groups; directly supervises staff, assigns responsibility to members; monitors progress.</li><li>Directly manage the career development of a team up to 5 while expanding to leading up to teams of 20 across various capabilities depending on the product.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Other Requirements:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Extended and unsociable hours may be required to meet target schedule dates.</li><li>Due to the nature of the global organization, national and/or international travel may be required.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Job Requirements:<br><br></strong><strong>Education<br><br></strong><ul><li>A degree in Computer Science or in a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.</li><li>One or more professional certificates to supplement formal education/experience in support of Service Delivery Management.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Experience<br><br></strong><ul><li>Minimum of 12 years of experience in consulting or IT implementation.</li><li>Direct experience in complex management activities including supplier management and the delivery of complex IT services to customers.</li><li>10+ years delivery with the AGILE development methodology</li><li>Ability to effectively manage priorities and staffing to ensure delivery of highest priority items.</li><li>Significant experience of developing and managing portfolio plans and planning demand in line with business priorities.</li><li>Direct experience in managing onshore and offshore staff and budgets.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Certifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Project management certification preferred (PMI/CAPM or PMP, PRINCE2).</li><li>Familiarity with ITIL preferred.</li><li>AGILE certification preferred.</li></ul>

title: BIM Product Owner
description: Who We Are We are a leading BIM company specializing in hands-on, field-focused Building Information Modeling (BIM) services. Since our establishment in 2007, we’ve grown into the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, with over 5,000 projects completed. Our dedicated team of more than 500 professionals delivers tailored BIM solutions, including MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM, by collaborating with architects, engineers, and owners to meet their specific needs. The Role As a Senior BIM Product Owne r, you will serve as the key intermediary between the production and development teams. You will be responsible for analyzing production requests and translating them into well-defined product requirements. This includes shaping user experiences, delivering detailed technical specifications, and ensuring that business objectives align with product vision and strategy Top Job Responsibilities Gathering and Documenting Requirement s: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze business requirements. Process Improvemen t: Identify and recommend improvements to business processes and workflows. Communication and Collaboratio n: Liaise between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables. Product Vision and Strateg y: Define, develop, and communicate the product vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals. Roadmap and Prioritizatio n: Create and maintain the product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements based on customer needs and business goals. Stakeholder Managemen t: Work with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing, and sales) to ensure successful product development and launch. Minimum Requirements and skills 5+ BIM Product Owner experience 5+ years of experience in product lifecycle management, with experience in agile methodologies. Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar certification. Advanced proficiency in English Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis tools (Excel, SQL). Knowledge of BIM or AEC. Familiarity with tools like Jira, SQL, Excel, and Revit is a plus . You are great for this role if you: Are adaptable and able to adjust to different industries, with experience in a variety of projects and products. Have experience working with data and applying it to business or product decisions. Company Culture and Values 🤝 Candor: We value honesty, openness, and sincerity in all interactions. 🎯 Accountability: We take ownership and are committed to delivering high-quality work on time. 🌟 Win-Win Mentality: We strive for mutual success in all business relationships. Why join us? Explore our amazing benefits! ✨ 🌍 Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space. 🌴No Policy for PTO: Recharge with flexible paid time off when you need it. 🎉 Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, fun challenges and team celebrations. 🎓Continuous Learning: Programs to develop your technical and soft skills. 💻Work Equipment to Keep You Productive: We provide everything you need to create the perfect workspace. 🎧Tech & Office Allowances: Upgrade your workspace with our one-time allowances. With "Pimp up your Devices," and “Home Office set up allowance” you can upgrade gadgets for a better experience. 📶 Monthly Internet Allowance: Stay connected with a monthly allowance for internet and expenses. 💵 Highly Competitive Compensation Package: Includes both fixed and variable payments, all processed in our local currency, USD.

title: AI Technical Product Manager
description: About You You are an AI Technical Product Manager who is passionate about building AI-powered products that solve real business problems and deliver measurable value. title: Product Owner (Recommendation Systems)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner (Recommendation Systems) based in Argentina. As a Product Owner, you will own the post-purchase customer experience, with a strong focus on activation, matching, relevance, and personalized recommendations. Your mission will be to help paying customers reach meaningful value as quickly as possible by improving how they discover and connect with relevant opportunities. You’ll work across product discovery, recommendation systems, segmentation, personalization, and experimentation. Using data, research, and product intuition, you’ll identify bottlenecks and turn them into measurable product opportunities. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering, design, analytics, and data/ML teams to turn hypotheses into impactful product improvements. This is an end-to-end ownership role in a remote, international, and fast-moving product environment. Accountabilities Own the post-purchase customer journey, focusing on activation, matching, relevance, and the speed at which paying customers reach meaningful value. Optimize offer volume and recommendation quality so customers receive a relevant selection without being overwhelmed or underserved. Improve the relevance and trustworthiness of recommendations and increase the number of relevant invitations reaching paying customers. Increase the likelihood that new customers achieve a quality match during their first week. Design and improve engagement mechanics such as gamification, nudges, reminders, and conversation reactivation features. Analyze matching parameters across user segments and apply segmentation, personalization, and data enrichment to improve recommendation outcomes. Identify bottlenecks and growth opportunities across the post-purchase journey using quantitative data, qualitative research, and product insight. Translate product opportunities into clear, testable hypotheses with defined success metrics and measurable outcomes. Partner with engineers, designers, analysts, and data/ML specialists to prioritize, develop, test, and launch product improvements. Manage product requirements, priorities, and delivery timelines to ensure efficient and predictable execution. Run A/B tests and other product experiments, analyze results and metrics, and iterate or scale solutions based on evidence. Take end-to-end ownership of product outcomes, focusing on measurable impact rather than process for its own sake. Requirements Hands-on B2C product experience, particularly in customer experience, customer journey design, activation, onboarding, or first-session experiences. Experience working with discovery-driven products involving large volumes of offers, listings, or potential matches. Practical understanding of search and feed relevance, matching systems, recommendation engines, personalization, or related product experiences. Experience with segmentation, personalization, and enriching offers or listings with additional data. Relevant experience in marketplaces, aggregators, dating or social discovery, real estate, classifieds, e-commerce with large catalogs, or other discovery- and recommendation-driven products. Strong ability to formulate product hypotheses, define clear requirements, and establish measurable success criteria. Proven ability to drive product delivery from idea through implementation and evaluation. Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and other product experiments. Comfortable combining qualitative and quantitative research to understand customer behavior and validate product decisions. Strong understanding of product metrics and the ability to identify meaningful growth opportunities from data. Effective cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with designers, analysts, engineers, and data/ML specialists. Results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and willingness to make decisions independently. Comfortable working with changing priorities and ambiguity in a fast-paced product environment. Clear, direct communication skills and a willingness to treat failures and experiments as opportunities for learning. Benefits Fully remote, full-time opportunity. Initial compensation level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process before employment begins. 28 calendar days of vacation per year. 7 additional wellness days annually for personal, household, or recovery needs. Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations. 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and professional events. Corporate discounts for English language lessons. Health benefits, including up to $1,000 gross per year toward self-purchased health insurance or eligible medical expenses when corporate medical insurance is not available. Workplace equipment and setup support, including reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross once every three years for eligible home-office or coworking expenses outside company-provided locations. Internal gamified recognition program with rewards that can be exchanged for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other perks. Opportunity to work within a globally distributed, remote-first environment with an international team. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Manager - Argentina
description: Nuestro equipo de Producto Nuestro equipo de Producto es responsable de desarrollar, crear y lanzar nuevas funcionalidades que impulsan el ecosistema de Tiendanube, en colaboración con los equipos de Diseño e Ingeniería. Trabajarás en un entorno técnico de alta complejidad, actuando como el enlace estratégico que conecta las necesidades del negocio con las soluciones de ingeniería y arquitectura de backend. El tamaño de tu desafío Liderar la estrategia y el roadmap del producto, asegurando que las decisiones sobre la plataforma estén alineadas con la visión a largo plazo de Tiendanube; Actuar como socio técnico del equipo de Ingeniería, liderando debates en profundidad sobre arquitectura y funcionalidades, garantizando que el producto y el diseño sean parte del proceso de toma de decisiones; Llevar a cabo procesos de investigación técnica, validando hipótesis y anticipando los cuellos de botella que puedan afectar la escalabilidad del ecosistema; Identificar las fricciones y oportunidades en la gestión de productos, priorizando las entregas que generen mayor valor para los merchants y partners; Comunicar y alinear stakeholders de distintos niveles, traduciendo desafíos técnicos complejos en narrativas claras de impacto y valor de negocio; Lo que buscamos Sólida experiencia en gestión de productos para plataformas SaaS o sistemas a gran escala; Sólidos conocimientos técnicos, con familiaridad con arquitecturas de microservicios, API y modelado de datos complejos; Capacidad para influir y negociar, demostrando resiliencia para cuestionar y ser cuestionado por equipos técnicos de alto nivel; Perfil analítico y orientado a los datos, con capacidad para tomar decisiones basadas en la evidencia y medir el éxito mediante indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) claros; Una visión sistémica y orientada al negocio, que logra un equilibrio entre la excelencia técnica, la rapidez en la entrega y el impacto para el cliente final; Experiencia en la gestión de roadmap en escenarios inciertos y altamente complejos (desde cero o a gran escala). Nuestro proceso Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition va a analizar tu perfil con atención e, independientemente del resultado, vas a recibir una respuesta. Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto con vos durante todo el proceso. Lo que te proponemos Cobertura de salud OSDE 310 para el grupo familiar (cónyuge + hijos); Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas; Reintegro del servicio de Internet; Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse; La asistencia de guardería es un beneficio que tiene como objetivo apoyar a los colaboradores en la provisión de un entorno seguro para sus hijos desde los 45 días de vida, hasta los 3 años de edad, durante tu jornada laboral; Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes; 15 días hábiles de vacaciones a lo largo del año; Además de las vacaciones, disponemos de una semana de descanso para recargar energías entre final/principio de nuevo año; Una Tiendanube gratuita para vos o alguien de tu entorno; Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación, siempre que el rol lo permita; Es un entorno de desafío constante, propósito y protagonismo — acá la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante. Política de Privacidad Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos. Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos. Para obtener más información sobre cómo manejamos los datos, incluidos tus derechos según la ley, simplemente accedé a nuestra Política de Privacidad.

title: Product Manager
description: <strong>Job Title: Product Manager<br><br></strong><strong>A bit about us: <br><br></strong>We’re on a mission to change the tire industry — how it’s delivered and how it’s experienced. A pioneer in the automotive e-commerce industry, we take pride in our extensive selection of top-name brands and budget-friendly options, ensuring our customers find the perfect tire to suit their needs. As a part of our growing and dynamic team, you'll contribute to our commitment to exceptional service, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Embrace the opportunity to be a driving force behind one of the fastest growing e-commerce companies in the US and apply now!<br><br><strong>Summary<br><br></strong>The Product Manager will be responsible for defining and delivering the product capabilities that support Garage Hub's auto parts distribution platform as well as Tires Easy's Driveline platform. This role focuses on building systems that enable accurate product data, efficient catalog management, pricing integrity, and scalable internal workflows across a growing supplier-, customer-, and SKU- base. This position plays a central role in ensuring that these platforms reliably support customer- and distributor-specific needs such as part compatibility, order management, inventory visibility, and pricing logic.<br><br>The Product Manager will work closely with Operations, Engineering, and Strategic Partnerships teams to translate distributor and customer requirements into product solutions that improve catalog accuracy, pricing consistency, inventory transparency, sales, and execution. The ideal candidate is a Product Manager with experience in distribution, e-commerce, marketplace, or inventory-driven businesses who understands the operational realities of managing complex catalogs and supplier data in high-volume, data-intensive environments.<br><br><strong>Essential Duties And Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Own the product definition and delivery of Garage Hub's and Driveline's core distribution platform capabilities.</li><li>Design and evolve systems that support order management, catalog ingestion, part normalization, and data quality across customers and suppliers, including UX/UI where applicable.</li><li>Partner with Engineering to plan and deliver product releases that support customer and distributor workflows and scale.</li><li>Work closely with Operations and Strategic Partnerships teams to understand distribution-specific constraints (shipping logic, catalog complexity, pricing rules, inventory data, supplier variability) and translate them into product requirements.</li><li>Partner directly with Operations to identify and resolve pain points, validate requirements, and ensure solutions are practical and adopted in live operating environments.</li><li>Define and maintain a prioritized roadmap aligned to distributor/customer needs and business objectives.</li><li>Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through automation, tooling, and workflow redesign.</li><li>Communicate product priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery timelines clearly to stakeholders.</li><li>Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with evolving requirements and limited precedent.</li><li>Other duties as assigned.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualification Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor's degree from a top academic institution.</li><li>4-8+ years of product management experience in B2B, marketplace, e-commerce, or other operations- and data-intensive environments.</li><li>Strong business judgment with a clear understanding of how product decisions impact operational execution, cost, and scalability.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to ship, iterate, and improve complex products in fast-moving organizations.</li><li>Experience working cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, and Analytics teams to deliver scalable, business-ready solutions.</li><li>Proven ability to translate ambiguous, real-world business problems into clear, actionable product requirements.</li><li>Data-driven mindset with comfort using metrics, dashboards, and analysis to inform prioritization and tradeoffs.</li><li>Strong organizational and execution skills with a clear bias toward delivery over process.</li><li>Comfortable operating in high-growth, entrepreneurial, and ambiguous environments; startup or early-stage experience preferred.</li><li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly around requirements, prioritization, and decision-making.</li><li>Proficient in Microsoft Office; familiarity with common product management and analytics tools strongly preferred.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Physical Demands<br><br></strong>Physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.<br><br>While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit; stand; walk; use hands, handle/feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must occasionally push, pull, or lift from below the waist, or lift from an overhead position and carry 5-10 pounds. title: TECHNICAL PRODUCT MANAGER
description: Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a Technical Product Manager, AI Agent Teamfor a full-time position (40 hours per week) in Argentina and Colombia. Our client is building a team of engineers dedicated to agentic and AI-driven workflows — automating and augmenting work across the organization, with an emphasis on Performance Marketing operations. The team has been operating with a high degree of technical autonomy and has made real progress, but it currently lacks a dedicated product/delivery function: there's no single owner translating business priorities into a prioritized roadmap, no consistent process for scoping and tracking work, and no single point of contact between engineering and the business stakeholders who depend on this work. We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to close that gap. This is a build-it-from-scratch role: you'll bring structure, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment to a fast-moving, highly technical team, without slowing down the things that are already working. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity early on and confident enough to bring order to it. Working schedule: 9 am - 5 pm EST (full overlap with EST). Requirements Hands-on experience building agentic workflows yourself or working closely with teams that build them, so you understand what these systems can and can't do — not just the underlying concepts. Experience as a Technical Product Manager or in a similar role, working directly with engineers on fast-moving, ambiguous technical initiatives. A track record of building product processes (roadmapping, backlog management, sprint planning) from scratch on a team that didn't have them before. Strong stakeholder management skills — able to build credibility with both engineers and senior business stakeholders and translate between the two. Comfortable operating with real decision-making authority: this role is expected to drive priorities and hold the team accountable to them, not simply intake and relay requests. A clear, direct communicator, including with stakeholders who are not deeply technical. Will be a plus Experience with AI/ML, LLM-based, or workflow automation products. Experience with performance marketing or marketing data. Experience managing an external vendor or contractor relationship. Background in mortgage, lending, fintech, or marketing technology. Responsibilities Partner with engineering leads and business stakeholders to build and maintain a prioritized roadmap, replacing the team's current ad hoc, project-by-project approach. Own scoping and definition of work: turn open-ended technical initiatives into clear epics, well-defined stories, and tracked milestones with clear end states. Establish consistent operating norms for the team — sprint planning, backlog refinement, and story estimation. When needed, act as a liaison between engineering and business stakeholders, translating business goals into technical priorities and representing engineering constraints back to the business. Drive stakeholder engagement and discovery for new initiatives, ensuring new work has clear sponsorship and a defined outcome. Own our "citizen builder" process: audit the tools and dashboards business users have built on Replit and Claude, prioritize which are worth operationalizing, and define the plan to get them there. Report progress, risks, and priorities to leadership on a regular cadence. WE OFFER US and EU projects based on advanced technologies. Competitive compensation based on skills and experience. Comprehensive private medical insurance. Regular performance appraisals to support your growth. Flexibility in workspace, either remote, our welcoming office or local coworking. Bonuses for recommendations of new employees. Bonuses for article writing, public talks, other activities. 15 vacation days, 10 national holidays, 10 sick leaves. Personalized learning program tailored to your interests and skill development. Free tech webinars and meetups organized by Svitla. Fun corporate online\offline celebrations and activities. Well-established remote culture. Awesome team, friendly and supportive community!

You will be responsible for identifying problems and opportunities, setting priorities, and taking initiatives from initial discovery through launch and measurement. We need someone who can connect these perspectives, make informed decisions, and explain why an initiative should be prioritized. You will work closely with Design and Engineering to build solutions, and with other teams to make sure they work in practice. We are looking for someone with sound product judgment who can challenge a request when the underlying problem is unclear and take ownership of the outcome after launch. Evaluate options and make trade-offs across customer impact, business value, risk, operational needs, and implementation effort. Work with Design and Engineering to shape solutions and guide them through development and launch. Align Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Data on decisions that affect each initiative. Measure results after launch and improve the product based on what you learn. Strong product judgment: you can analyze ambiguous problems, evaluate options, recommend priorities, and explain your decisions. What we offer The opportunity to work on financial products with a direct impact on customers and business growth. Room to propose ideas, make decisions, and influence how we build products at Kiwi. Close collaboration with Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Data. An environment where AI is becoming part of how we work and build. 100% remote work from Argentina, Colombia, or the Dominican Republic.

right candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where business needs are urgent, systems are complex, and engineering ownership boundaries are still being formalized.<br><br><strong>Insight on Your Impact:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, business analysts, users, and GEO engineering teams.</li><li>Collect, clarify, and organize business requests before they reach engineering teams.</li><li>Convert business needs into clear, engineering-ready backlog items with scope, acceptance criteria, priority, dependencies, and expected outcomes.</li><li>Protect engineering teams from unmanaged direct requests, unclear requirements, and shifting priorities.</li><li>Partner with sequencing.</li><li>Maintain and prioritize product / delivery backlogs for assigned systems or product groups.</li><li>Coordinate delivery planning, sprint / iteration planning, release scope, and business outcomes.</li><li>Communicate delivery status, risks, tradeoffs, and changes clearly to stakeholders and GEO leadership.</li><li>Help define release notes, user-facing communication, rollout plans, and post-release feedback loops.</li><li>Ensure that production issues, defects, enhancement requests, and technical debt items are captured, prioritized, and routed correctly.</li><li>Support incident follow-up by helping translate business impact into clear backlog items, corrective actions, or improvement requests.</li><li>Maintain practical documentation for product decisions, requirements, acceptance criteria, process flows, and stakeholder agreements.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Your Qualifications, Your Influence:<br><br></strong><ul><li>5+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, delivery management, business systems delivery, or similar roles.</li><li>Experience working with internal software platforms, enterprise applications, ERP systems, warehouse systems, operations systems, or B2B transaction platforms.</li><li>Strong ability to translate business problems into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery ambiguous requirements, urgent stakeholder requests, and changing business needs.</li><li>Strong communication skills with the ability to explain delivery status, scope, tradeoffs, risks, and dependencies to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li><li>Ability to work with senior stakeholders while still staying close to daily delivery details.</li><li>Strong ownership mindset, structured thinking, and practical problem-solving skills.</li><li>Ability to build process discipline without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Skills and Business Familiartity:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience with software platforms used in supply chain, distribution, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, or electronic components industries.</li><li>Experience supporting internal business platforms used by sales, purchasing, warehouse, finance, operations, or customer service teams.</li><li>Experience with .NET / SQL Server-based enterprise systems or similar business-critical platforms.</li><li>Familiarity with mobile applications, warehouse workflows, computer vision, NLP, AI / ML use cases, or data-driven internal tools.</li><li>Experience coordinating delivery across globally distributed teams.</li><li>Experience working with business analysts, technical product owners, architects, QA leads, DevOps engineers, DBAs, and infrastructure teams.</li><li>Understanding of production support, defect triage, release readiness, and incident follow-up processes.</li><li>Experience improving backlog quality, acceptance criteria, UAT discipline, and stakeholder communication in an organization where process maturity is still developing.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Success in the First 90 Days:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Understand assigned business systems, key stakeholders, current delivery flow, and major pain points.</li><li>Establish a clear intake and prioritization process for assigned product groups or systems.</li><li>Create or clean up the working backlog so engineering teams can see clear priorities, requirements, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.</li><li>Build working relationships with business stakeholders, Engineering Managers, Team Leads / Architects, QA, DevOps, DBA, and Infrastructure teams.</li><li>Improve visibility into current work, delivery risks, blockers, and upcoming releases.</li><li>Establish a practical UAT coordination process with business stakeholders and users.</li><li>Reduce unmanaged direct requests to engineers by routing work through the agreed intake and backlog process.</li><li>Identify major gaps in requirements quality, stakeholder alignment, release readiness, and delivery communication.</li><li>Start producing clear delivery status updates for GEO leadership and business stakeholders.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What This Role Does Not Own:<br><br></strong>This role does not own formal people management for title: Product Owner
description: Description The Business Analyst plays a critical role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution across a multi-surface SaaS platform. Working closely with Product Managers, engineering, design, and business stakeholders, this role is responsible for eliciting, analyzing, and transforming complex business requirements into clear, actionable functional specifications and user stories for both web management portals and native mobile applications. The Business Analyst actively manages and refines the product backlog, ensures alignment during Agile delivery, and continuously maps and optimizes user workflows. Success in this role requires a sharp analytical mindset, deep technical understanding, and the ability to ensure that delivered features provide high operational efficiency and measurable business value. Responsibilities Requirements Analysis & Process Optimization Gather, analyze, and map complex business processes, user journeys, and operational workflows across web and mobile platforms. Elicit detailed business rules and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, translating them into comprehensive functional specifications. Identify process bottlenecks and operational inefficiencies, proposing scalable digital solutions to optimize user experience. Backlog Management & Product Ownership Support Own, groom, and maintain the operational product backlog in alignment with product priorities and business objectives. Translate high-level business goals into precise user stories, detailed acceptance criteria (Given-When-Then), and flow diagrams. Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives), acting as the functional authority for the delivery team. Support product managers in feature prioritization by assessing technical feasibility, business value, and operational impact. Cross-Functional Alignment & Delivery Serve as the primary functional bridge between business stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Customer Success) and technical teams (Engineering, UX/UI, QA). Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture teams to ensure functional requirements align with technical constraints, APIs, and integrations. Assist QA teams in reviewing test plans and execution scripts to ensure full coverage of acceptance criteria and functional scope. Facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and support change management and release communication efforts. Data-Driven Insights & Continuous Improvement Analyze system usage, operational KPIs, and workflow metrics to identify trends and functional gaps. Use quantitative data and stakeholder feedback to recommend functional enhancements and backlog improvements. Maintain clear, up-to-date functional documentation, process maps, and system requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Product Owner on complex B2B SaaS platforms or multi-platform digital products. Demonstrated experience creating detailed functional specs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow diagrams (BPMN, UML) for responsive web and native mobile apps (iOS/Android). Solid understanding of backend concepts, APIs, data modeling, and system integration logic to collaborate effectively with engineering teams. Hands-on experience in Agile/Scrum environments, managing backlogs, and using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Linear. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills with acute attention to detail. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Advanced English level (C1), both written and spoken. What We Offer Competitive compensation and benefits package. Opportunities for growth and professional development. Comprehensive leave policies, including PTO, sick leave, and study leave. Access to employee discount programs. Monthly connectivity allowance. About Us At Nybble Group, we are dedicated to transforming businesses with the power of technology. For over 20 years, we have helped clients optimize operations and increase productivity through process automation, smart document processing, and advanced data analytics. We believe in fostering a collaborative and innovative culture where every team member can thrive.

description: <em>To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.<br><br></em>Job Category<br><br>Product<br><br>Job Details<br><br><strong>About Salesforce<br><br></strong>Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.<br><br>Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.<br><br><strong>Senior Technical Product Owner, Energy<br><br></strong><strong>Location:</strong> LATAM (Brazil or Argentina) - Remote<br><br><strong>Department Description<br><br></strong>The mission of the Solutions Center of Excellence (CoE) is to build, deliver, and support demonstration environments for use by our Solution Engineers (SEs) globally. These environments incorporate the latest Salesforce capabilities, providing the baseline required to deliver best-practice demos. We enable our SEs to scale, innovate, and provide the best product demonstrations of their careers.<br><br><strong>Role Description<br><br></strong>We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Owner to execute the technical strategy for our Energy sector. In this critical role, you will bridge business requirements and platform execution by managing the delivery of high-impact technical initiatives. You will be responsible for translating market requirements into prioritized backlogs, mapping demo assets to industry use cases, and ensuring that our demo environments are robust, secure, and built on the latest Salesforce architecture.<br><br>Roles and Responsibilities<br><br><ul><li>Strategic Vision &amp; Roadmap (Trusted Partner)</li><ul><li>Align demo initiatives with product and industry roadmaps, flagging misalignments early and communicating shifts clearly to stakeholders.</li><li>Build strong, trust-based relationships across Product, Solutions, and Demo Tech, leveraging collaboration to resolve misalignment and maintain delivery.</li><li>Identify risks or conflicts early and escalate with clear context, ensuring issues are addressed quickly to protect outcomes.</li></ul><li>Project/Program Management (Business Owner)</li><ul><li>Prioritize backlog items to align with team goals, keep the backlog well-groomed and transparent, and define clear acceptance criteria.</li><li>Re-prioritize work in response to changing needs, maintain pace amid scope shifts, and use ceremonies to realign the team.</li><li>Suggest actionable process improvements, encourage experimentation with new practices, and track outcomes of changes.</li></ul><li>Communication &amp; Collaboration (Translator &amp; Collaborator)</li><ul><li>Translate technical details into business value for stakeholders, bridging gaps between developers, PMs, and SEs to ensure mutual understanding.</li><li>Conduct structured discussions to extract detailed requirements, distinguishing needs from nice-to-haves and converting them into backlog-ready items.</li><li>Facilitate discussions to resolve competing priorities, encouraging balanced input while maintaining focus on shared outcomes.</li></ul><li>In-depth Industry &amp; Product Knowledge (Team Seller)</li><ul><li>Apply Salesforce capabilities to address industry-specific scenarios, explaining how features connect to customer processes and staying current with new releases.</li><li>Maintain industry demo environments reliably, troubleshooting common issues independently and sharing updates on readiness.</li><li>Map demo assets to industry and customer problems, identifying opportunities for reuse and documenting solution coverage clearly.<br></li></ul></ul>Basic Requirements<br><br><ul><li>Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of professional experience, with a strong background in Product Ownership, Solution Engineering, or Product Management.</li><li>Industry Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Energy industry, with the ability to understand market trends and align them with technical solutions.</li><li>Salesforce Certifications: Salesforce Administrator (Required), Agentforce Specialist or Data Cloud certification (Required, can be obtained during ramping), Advanced Administrator,</li><li>Agile &amp; Scrum Mastery: Experience managing backlogs and executing sprints as a Product Owner in an Agile/Scrum environment. CSM or PSM Certified.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>Technical Fluency: Comfort working in developer tools like GitHub, including reviewing Pull Requests (PRs), understanding version control workflows, and basic code literacy (e.g., LWC, Apex, or JSON) to collaborate closely with engineering teams.</li><li>Experience: Experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives, or previous experience as a Solution Engineer (SE), Technical Business Analyst, or in a pre-sales environment.</li><li>Cloud Expertise: Specific experience with Salesforce Energy &amp; Utilities Cloud.</li><li>Scrum Certification: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.<br><br></li></ul>Unleash Your Potential<br><br>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and <em>be your best</em>, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can <em>do your best</em>. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.<br><br>Accommodations<br><br>If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.<br><br>Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.<br><br>Posting Statement<br><br>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description: At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1. We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey. This is not a coordination role. You will own the layer of ASAPP’s platform that connects GenerativeAgent to the real world — integrations, SDKs, agent interoperability, voice channels, and the developer experience that underpins all of it. These are load-bearing systems: if they do not work, customers cannot deploy our solution and deals do not close. You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans API Connections (our integration hub), the developer SDKs, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interoperability, MCP servers, workflows, and telephony integrations. You will work directly with engineering leads across these areas and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders. The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves, so the strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target — and will bring the technical depth to anticipate what the right target is. What You Will Do You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely. Own the API Connections platform and manage the backlog of platform bets. Manage the commercial relationship with our third-party providers. Define and execute the A2A and MCP server roadmap. Customers are agentifying their internal workflows and want our agentic solutions to orchestrate against them. Decide how and when to expose these externally, and shape broader strategies so multiple teams build coherently rather than in isolation. Lead the developer SDKs. The SDK is the surface through which end users experience ASAPP. Own the roadmap and ensure investments stay aligned with the underlying platform. Manage telephony and platform integrations — the connective tissue between our solution and customers’ CCaaS stacks. Triage inbound requests with a bias toward saying no cleanly and early; the approach for each integration pattern is defined and the goal is disciplined execution, not proliferation. Own external documentation (docs.asapp.com) as part of the product. Define the structure, processes, and standards — working with the team to execute. Drive a docs-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them. Across All Of These Areas Set strategy and own the roadmap — balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets. Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage and prune the backlog; say no with clarity and evidence. Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data-driven. Who You Are We evaluate candidates against a set of principles. These are not interview talking points — they describe how PMs are expected to operate here every day. Growth & Abundance Mindset: You approach new domains with curiosity and learn fast. You see collaboration as additive, not competitive. When a bet does not work, you extract the signal and move on. Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You do not wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the PM; the outcome is yours. High-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer “what changed for the customer?” for everything on your roadmap. Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned. You know when to drive consensus and when to make a call. Real-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously. You do not save it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively. What You Will Need 5+ years of product management experience in enterprise B2B SaaS and native AI platforms. Technical depth to engage credibly with engineers on API design, SDK architecture, integration patterns, and AI/ML tradeoffs — you are hands-on producing working prototypes and you need to understand production code. Demonstrated ability to own a complex, multi-surface product area with minimal oversight. Experience working directly with enterprise customers and delivery teams to translate pain into prioritized roadmap. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving to clarity — you can structure an undefined problem before engineering has to. Track record of shipping: you have owned features from discovery through delivery, including the parts that are not exciting. What We Would Like To See Expert with integration platform or developer experience products (API gateways, SDKs, MCP/A2A protocols, webhooks, OAuth flows) Experience with voice or telephony products, CCaaS platforms Proven background in enterprise onboarding Comfort navigating AI/ML systems — not just as a user but as someone who can reason about model behavior, latency tradeoffs, and accuracy/trust requirements Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment where the role definition evolved as the company did Experience owning or meaningfully improving developer-facing documentation — API references, integration guides, and SDK docs. Benefits Competitive compensation Stock options Healthcare for the family group Mac equipment USD 150 per month in flexible benefits 3 weeks of vacation English lessons ASAPP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. If you have a disability and need assistance with our employment application process, please email us at [email protected] to obtain assistance. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Product Owner
description: JOB DUCK IS HIRING A PRODUCT OWNER For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive. As a lifestyle company we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification for 4 years! Role Overview The Talent Community Product Owner is accountable for maximizing the value delivered by the Talent Community product and lifecycle (portal experience + candidate/Staffer journeys), enhancing the overall experience within the Job Duck Talent Community, from Candidates preparing for placement to Staffers advancing in their careers. This role owns the Talent Community product vision and roadmap, prioritizing the backlog to maximize member quality, readiness, and placement outcomes. Working through the Talent Community Committee and delivery partners, it aligns cross-functional efforts, establishes clear product goals, manages tradeoffs, and drives continuous improvement, using data to support broader organizational goals. Schedule: Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM EST (USA) Your Responsibilities Will Include but Are Not Limited To: Translating Talent Community strategy into clear product goals, success measures, and backlog priorities. Owning and maintaining a transparent backlog and roadmap, prioritizing by value, effort, risk, and dependencies, and pushing back on misaligned requests to protect focus and capacity. Running the Talent Community Committee cadence for intake, prioritization, decisioning, escalation, and dependency management, keeping stakeholders aligned on priorities, constraints, and rationale. Defining and communicating the Talent Community product goal(s) and success measures, aligned to business priorities. Publishing outcome readouts tied to KPIs and experiments (what changed, what moved, what's next) and using the insights to re-prioritize. Defining "ready" work by turning needs into clear backlog items with user stories and acceptance criteria for features, enhancements, and workflows. Partnering with cross-functional owners to clarify scope, manage tradeoffs, and ship high-quality iterations that deliver measurable value. Representing the candidate/Staffer voice in prioritization and decision-making across the product lifecycle. Leading continuous improvement by using candidate/Staffer feedback and performance data to identify friction, run pilots/A/B tests when appropriate, scale what works, and stop what doesn't. What We’re Looking For: At least three years of experience in a Product Owner (or equivalent) role with backlog ownership and demonstrated prioritization authority. Experience defining success metrics (KPIs) and using performance insights to reprioritize roadmaps/backlogs. Familiarity with experimentation and measurement (A/B testing, segmentation/cohorts, funnel analysis). Experience leading cross-functional governance (cadences, decisioning, escalation, dependency alignment) and managing stakeholder tradeoffs. Experience partnering with technical delivery teams in iterative environments (preferred). Experience in staffing, talent acquisition, onboarding, lifecycle programs, or talent development (preferred). Technical skills (Required) : BI and dashboard literacy, Experimentation and measurement, Data interpretation and insight communication, Requirements documentation, Data quality and governance basics Technical skills (Preferred): Data querying literacy, Automation/analysis tooling familiarity, Version control familiarity, Data pipeline and integration awareness, Transformation framework awareness Behavioral Skills (Required): Business acumen, Stakeholder management, Coaching and feedback Reliable computer setup (laptop/PC, headset, stable internet min. 10 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload) Quiet, distraction-free remote work environment What’s In It for You? Paid time off . 100% Remote, Full-Time, Long-Term Career Opportunity. Parental leave. Opportunities for professional development and training Dedicated support from our team. A chance to work with clients who share our values. Ready to dive in? Apply now and make sure to follow all the instructions! DISCLAIMER: Every candidate must pass each step in our application process to become part of our team. Ensure you have all the required documentation ready to streamline your application process.
