title: Senior Product Manager - Remote
description: We are seeking a Senior Product Manager for a Short-Term Contract to lead the integration and expansion of a rapidly growing digital health platform that unifies clinical and wellness services into a single user experience. This role will focus on defining how new offerings—including diagnostics, genetics, prescribing, and emerging therapeutic products—are integrated into the platform in a cohesive, scalable way. The ideal candidate brings deep experience at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and product management, with strong knowledge of healthcare workflows, regulatory considerations, and AI-native product development. This is a highly collaborative, remote consulting engagement requiring significant overlap with US Eastern Time and close partnership with engineering, clinical, compliance, and executive stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Define and lead product integration strategy across the platform, ensuring new offerings fit seamlessly into existing workflows, data models, and user experiences. Partner with leadership and clinical teams to transform emerging product concepts into clearly defined, scoped, and deliverable solutions. Identify opportunities to standardize workflows, UX patterns, and platform capabilities while maintaining necessary product-specific requirements. Develop and prioritize product roadmaps across multiple initiatives, balancing business objectives, user needs, and technical constraints. Collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture, integrations, and platform scalability considerations. Translate complex clinical, operational, and regulatory requirements into intuitive, compliant product experiences. Leverage modern AI tools and methodologies to accelerate product development and identify meaningful AI-driven opportunities for patients and providers. Define success metrics, monitor product performance, gather user insights, and drive continuous iteration and improvement. Facilitate alignment across distributed, cross-functional teams operating across multiple time zones. Core Requirements 6+ years of product management experience with a proven track record of shipping successful products and owning significant product areas. Strong experience within healthcare , wellness, clinical services, diagnostics, longevity, functional health, or related healthcare technology sectors. Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including engineering, clinical, operations, and compliance teams. Experience designing and managing platform-based products that integrate multiple services, workflows, or third-party systems. Working knowledge of HIPAA , healthcare data privacy, PHI handling, consent management, and regulatory considerations. Strong understanding of product architecture, integrations, data models, and workflow design. Experience utilizing modern AI tools and AI-enabled product development practices. Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and bring structure, clarity, and alignment to evolving product initiatives. Excellent prioritization, roadmap planning, and stakeholder management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English . Ability to work independently in a remote , fast-paced environment. Nice-to-Have Experience with diagnostics, genetics, laboratory ordering and results workflows, prescription management, or telehealth products. Familiarity with direct-to-consumer healthcare models, provider-network platforms, or digital health operations. Experience integrating third-party clinical, wellness, or healthcare services into a unified product ecosystem. Familiarity with: Healthie (EHR / HIPAA-compliant care platform) Keragon (HIPAA-compliant workflow automation) Health Gorilla (lab data integration) Go High Level (CRM and marketing automation) Fullscript (supplement dispensing) Thinkific (learning management platform) Additional US Timezone Overlap: Full daily overlap with US Eastern Time (EST/EDT) required. The icing on the Kake: 💵 Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally. 🏡 Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you. 🌱 Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions. ❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good. Please Note: Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Product Owner: Building Climate Solutions for Cities
description: Product Owner: Building Climate Solutions for Cities Link to application: https://noteforms.com/forms/product-owner-job-application-m6ylpo Have you built a solid career in technology and now want your work to actually matter? Open Earth Foundation is a California-based nonprofit on a mission to create groundbreaking technology that helps combat the climate crisis. Our flagship platform, CityCatalyst, supports cities around the world with data-driven climate planning and delivery. We’re a diverse, global team working remotely and collaborating with partners worldwide to make real change possible. With strong funding and a powerhouse team of innovators, we’re ready to tackle big challenges for a resilient Earth for generations to come and we need the planet’s brightest minds to help solve them! Your mission, should you choose to accept it: As a Product Owner at Open Earth Foundation, help drive the development of open-source climate data platforms like our main product CityCatalyst . You will work at the intersection of product, data, and program delivery: translating climate goals into engineering tasks, engaging directly with city governments and partners, and shipping with the team. This role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, learns fast, and is comfortable wearing many hats. You will be part of the product team and work directly with the other technical and product team members and a variety of team members in the organization. This position is fully remote and international as our organization works across different time zones. Schedule flexibility is expected with a willingness to collaborate in overlapping core hours for meetings from 8am PST to 11am PST (GMT-8) for org wide meetings and 9am-5pm EST collaboration times for overlap with the product team. Availability to work with overlapping hours across U.S., Latin American and European time zones is preferred. Priority will be given to applications submitted by July 24th. The following requirements describe our ideal candidate. If you don't meet some of the requirements, you're encouraged to apply anyway. Let us know if there is something missing and how we can work together to make it up. Essential Functions and Specific Duties: Own your initiative. Take end-to-end ownership of your initiative within the broader product roadmap — you steer its direction, priorities, and trade-offs, and you keep its backlog groomed and ready for the team. Run delivery. Ensure ticket refining, write user stories, manage backlog, and keep everyone unblocked. Comfortable in Jira, Linear, Notion, or equivalent tools. Keep track of deadlines and delivery. Get hands-on with code. Use AI-assisted tools (vibe coding, Claude Code, Cursor) to prototype, explore, and eventually contribute PRs when needed. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to dig in and willing to learn. Face the client. Run demos, workshops, and feedback sessions with city governments and institutional partners. Communicate complex data concepts clearly to non-technical audiences. Work with data. Understand and shape data pipelines, visualizations, and platform architectures. Collaborate with data engineers and scientists on meaningful outputs. Keep learning. Bring intellectual curiosity to every sprint. Explore new tools, frameworks, and approaches, then share what you find with the team. Sweat the details. Hold a high bar for quality and polish. Obsess over the details, catch the rough edges before users do, and care deeply about shipping things that are done right. Other: Actively participate in team building and culture development activities at Open Earth Foundation Qualifications: Proven experience in a product, technical, or delivery role — ideally at a startup or mission-driven tech organization. Ability to translate high-level goals into concrete engineering tasks and track them to completion. Confidence running presentations, client workshops, and stakeholder demos independently. Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day work — whether for writing, prototyping, automation, or research. Curiosity about what's next. Comfort using AI to understand code; willingness to eventually contribute code to the team's codebase. Fluent English (written and spoken) — mandatory. Available to join meetings in US Pacific & Eastern time zone when needed, even if based in a different time zone. Interpersonal Skills: Ability to work in an agile software development environment with a mix of data engineers, full-stack developers, product designers and product managers Ability to estimate and track time worked on tasks Communications skills necessary to document and present work Other Qualities: Dedication to fighting climate change Focus on impact Interest in non-profit work Bias for speed and iteration - you'd rather ship and improve than plan forever Compensation and Benefits: This position is full-time with compensation of $40,000-$55,000/year (USD) , dependent on experience and location (Paid in USD) Open Earth offers unlimited paid time off, paid holidays and paid sick leave You will work remotely within a dynamic and international environment We celebrate our achievements during our annual team retreat OEF is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, religion, national origin, or any other protected characteristic. We celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion in our teams and believe people should align their work with their purpose. Join us if you love Earth. We look forward to hearing from you! We use AI-assisted tools to help organize and summarize application materials. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by people.

description: <p><strong>Technical Product Manager Senior</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Bankingly es una plataforma SaaS B2B que le da canales de banca digital —web, mobile, onboarding, prevención de fraude— a más de 100 instituciones financieras en América Latina y otras regiones.</p><p><br></p><p>Estamos buscando a alguien que sea el motor de discovery de nuestra próxima generación de productos. No es un rol de escribir specs y esperar: es investigar el mercado FinTech de primera mano, construir con tus propias manos las Pruebas de Concepto que validan (o descartan) una idea, armar el caso de negocio, y ser quien da el ok final de calidad antes de que algo salga a producción.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Qué vas a hacer:</strong></p><ul><li>Trabajar codo a codo con el liderazgo ejecutivo (reportás al COO, y trabajás de cerca con CEO, CTO y Ventas) para definir y priorizar el roadmap de innovación.</li><li>Conocer el portafolio de Bankingly a fondo, y analizarlo todo el tiempo para encontrar fortalezas, brechas y oportunidades.</li><li>Investigar sin parar FinTech, banca digital, IA, ciberseguridad y tendencias regulatorias, y proponer iniciativas nuevas a partir de eso.</li><li>Liderar la validación técnica (PoCs, prototipos funcionales, evals cuando el producto tiene IA) y de mercado de cada iniciativa, y llegar a recomendaciones Go/No-Go con data real, no intuición.</li><li>Desarrollar la visión inicial de producto, el alcance y el business case de lo que sí se valida.</li><li>Ser el puente hacia desarrollo para que lo validado se convierta en producto escalable sin perder nada en el camino.</li><li>Como parte secundaria del rol (~20% del tiempo): acompañar la aceptación final —documentación, capacitación, QA, demo— de lo que vos mismo/a validaste en discovery, antes del lanzamiento.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Qué buscamos:</strong></p><ul><li>Ubicación en Argentina o Uruguay (preferentemente).</li><li>Que sepas construir prototipos y PoCs de forma autónoma, con tus propias manos (hands-on coding).</li><li>Manejo real de herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA (Claude Code o similares), prompt engineering e integraciones tipo MCP.</li><li>Experiencia sólida en arquitecturas cloud (Azure es un plus) e integración vía APIs.</li><li>Conocimiento profundo de tecnologías FinTech —pagos, IA/ML, seguridad— incluyendo frameworks de evaluación (evals) para productos con IA.</li><li>Conocimiento práctico de marcos regulatorios LATAM (KYC, AML, Open Banking/Finance), o capacidad demostrada de aprender rápido si no lo tenés todavía.</li><li>Visión de negocio: saber conectar una solución técnica con ingresos, eficiencia y diferenciación, y construir business cases con números reales.</li><li>Mentalidad analítica: te sentís cómodo/a estructurando problemas ambiguos hasta llegar a una recomendación Go/No-Go con evidencia.</li><li>Alta autonomía y comunicación clara con stakeholders ejecutivos.</li><li>Español profesional e inglés B2+ (para research y vendors).</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Cómo se ve el éxito a los 6 meses:</strong> validaste varias iniciativas end-to-end con PoCs funcionales, le diste al equipo ejecutivo recomendaciones Go/No-Go claras (un "No" bien fundamentado también cuenta como éxito), y te ganaste el lugar de gatekeeper final de lanzamiento —asegurando que cada producto nuevo salga documentado, probado y listo para el mercado.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>¿Te copa el desafío?</strong></p><p>Si te entusiasma más validar una idea con las manos en el código que quedarte esperando que otro la construya, y si te gusta ser vos quien dice "esto va" o "esto no va" con data en la mano, este rol es para vos. Postulá y charlamos.</p><p></p>

title: Senior Product Manager
description: About Apply APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com . LOCATION: APPLY is hybrid/remote-friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Latin America , preferably working in hours that align to PT (Pacific Timezone) or ET (Eastern Timezone) . Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees. THE ROLE: Responsibilities Build and champion product strategies and vision throughout client engagements, as well as brief and inspire internal team members to deliver on that vision. Retrieve and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders, other teams, and various research methods, workshop facilitation methodologies to shape requirements, features and end products. Take ownership over creating product plans and roadmaps with the buy-in of executive stakeholders. Prepare and review product requirements documents (PRD) - be meticulous in ensuring requirements of all types (client, business, user experience, design, technical, non-functional) are understood, documented, kept up-to-date, conflicts resolved, and finally communicated in a timely fashion to team members and client stakeholders. Organize product releases and priorities properly, ensuring compliance with business value expectations. Prepare recommendations to track product use and impact end users - define measurement plans for the digital products that we design and build. Build your skills using a repertoire of analytics tools. Ensure requirements have been delivered to specifications, defects have been managed through to resolution, and assess readiness for launch. Continuously prepare recommendations to expand product base and vision - based on data and research-driven insight. Add value to the team - you are not just an order-taker. You understand what it means to drive ROI through business and customer value, you understand the constraints from all directions, and you use your consultative skills to make recommendations to move vision forward. REQUIREMENTS: You are capable of detecting the main projects, initiatives, and epics that must be executed to achieve the expected business results. You are an effective communicator and facilitator, and are able to successfully manage expectations. You are experienced with backlog management, sprint planning, and roadmapping exercises, and you are able to generate spaces and workshops to define approaches and align solutions. You are a creative leader, a team player, and a problem solver. You are professional, confident, and able to understand which ideas will and which won’t work. You have proven yourself in a consultation role, through Agency, Consultancy, or other Professional Services Firm. You have strong proficiency in stakeholder management. Demonstrated experience using Contentful as a headless CMS for building and managing websites is a bonus. You’re good at techie speak and non-techie speak. You’ve collaborated in multidisciplinary teams, are able to convey technical concepts to non-technical people as well as turn business, UX, design requirements into technical specifications. It’s easy for you to break down complex problems into logical, digestible steps Ambiguity doesn’t scare you, and you thrive on turning ambiguity and conflicting information into clarity in a fast-changing environment. You have a portfolio of digital products that you have shipped, managed and operated, and are proud to share how it delivered value to end users. You have done it before, with a minimum of 7 years of experience in a Product Management or similar position. LIFE AT APPLY People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you: Agentic Delivery: Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact. An inclusive and safe environment: We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe. AI & Strategic Upskilling: Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work. Generous vacation policy: Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well-being. Flexible work arrangements: We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both. APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] . We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Sr Product Manager
description: <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong> to join Rootstrap's Product team in <strong>Argentina, Uruguay,</strong> and <strong>Colombia</strong>. Here at Rootstrap, we deliver exceptional work and have a great time doing it. Our Product team is growing, and we are looking for experienced product managers who can own outcomes end to end and work hand in hand with our clients in the USA.</p><p><br></p><p>As a Senior Product Manager at Rootstrap, you will shape and implement product visions for our clients while operating with a high degree of autonomy. You will be a product reference for the team, lead discovery and delivery for complex initiatives, and build enough trust with clients to influence their decisions. You will work alongside designers, engineers, and other departments to define the strategy and roadmap and bring the client's vision to life across the full product lifecycle, from concept to launch.</p><p><br></p><p>As AI reshapes the way digital products get built, the Product Manager's role becomes more strategic than ever. We are looking for PMs who deeply understand the client's business, are curious and comfortable working with modern tools, and can turn that understanding into a clear foundation the team can execute against with quality. We are not looking for engineers; we are looking for strong product thinkers who can define, guide, and validate the work.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What are the main responsibilities of this role?</strong></p><ul><li>Own the outcome (not just the output) for multiple initiatives in parallel, leading cross-functional teams.</li><li>Provide leadership in product discovery for products in the 0 to 1 and growth stages, largely autonomously, guiding the team in identifying opportunities and solutions.</li><li>Translate the client's business and goals into clear, well structured product definitions (PRDs, specs, and user stories) the team can build from, and be the reference for what a good outcome looks like.</li><li>Drive analytics by default: define measurement plans and own the implementation of product analytics tools (for example, Amplitude or Mixpanel), setting the success and quality criteria that tell us whether the product is working.</li><li>Manage stakeholders and their expectations, and build the trust needed to influence client decisions.</li><li>Elaborate and keep the roadmap, and be the vision keeper.</li><li>Write precise, efficient product specs, transforming requirements into user stories that can be developed on the sprints.</li><li>Participate actively in standard agile ceremonies (daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint retrospectives, sprint demos, etc.).</li><li>Collaborate with other leaders on the team, mentor semi-senior PMs, and work actively with stakeholders on the product strategy to drive outcome-oriented results.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Which skills and experience do we envision for this role?</strong></p><ul><li>Candidates must have a proven track record of successfully launching digital products (0 to 1 and growth) to the market. <em>(Required)</em></li><li>Minimum of 5+ years of experience as a product manager, preferably with a software development or technical background, which helps understand the product lifecycle, development processes, and the challenges of bringing new products to market. <em>(Required)</em></li><li>Operates with little or no supervision and can act as a product reference, able to lead a discovery of medium to high complexity end to end. <em>(Required)</em></li><li>Curious and comfortable working with modern AI tools, with a working understanding of how to apply them in product work, enough to define, guide, and validate, without needing to build it yourself. <em>(Valued)</em></li><li>A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as computer science, engineering, or a technical field, is beneficial.</li><li>Experience working closely with product teams, designers, and engineers to deliver the highest quality user experience.</li><li>You can demonstrate your Product Management skills: prioritization, discovery, analytics, negotiation, facilitation, ownership, and research.</li><li>Advanced experience with the Agile development process and a clear understanding of the digital product development lifecycle.</li><li>Proven relevant technical skills, data analysis, technical writing, implementation of product analytics tools, A/B testing, and programming basics are a plus.</li><li>Excellent stakeholder management and an outcome-oriented mindset.</li><li>Advanced or bilingual English for non-native speakers. <em>(Required)</em></li><li>Located in Latin America, we primarily work with clients in the EST and PST time zones, accommodating their schedules as needed.</li><li>Nice to have: experience in data-heavy or regulated domains (for example, fintech or healthtech), agency or consulting experience, and a history of mentoring other PMs.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Join our team and enjoy:</strong></p><ul><li>Access to Rootstrap University, Conferences/Certifications, and a Mentorship Program for your professional growth.</li><li>Opportunities to organize cross-functional initiatives and receive 360 Feedback to improve your skills continuously.</li><li>The flexibility to work remotely or from our offices in Montevideo, Buenos Aires, and Medellín, with a flexible schedule and Workation program.</li><li>Gym benefits, psychological counseling, and weekly lunch reimbursements with special foods in the offices.</li><li>An Onboarding kit and access to cutting-edge technologies and tools to make your work easier.</li><li>Referrals program bonuses, After Offices, Prizes, and special occasions gifts to celebrate your achievements.</li><li>People Care referent to support your well-being and personal development.</li></ul><p>We value your well-being and happiness. <strong>We grow together</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>How we work:</strong></p><ul><li>We offer a flexible and diverse work environment that fosters multicultural talent</li><li>We value autonomy and creativity, we want people to bring ideas to the table and to think as leaders</li><li>We put our focus on real human connections</li><li>We have a commitment to excellence</li></ul><p><br></p><p>At Rootstrap, we help companies launch, grow, and scale their digital products and services. With over 290 global team members, we've built products for clients like MasterClass, Universal, Google, as well as innovative startups and inspired pioneers. Earning regular recognition with Fastest Growing Company &amp; Best B2B Service Provider Industry accolades, our team prides itself on making an impact that transcends our efforts. We have offices in Uruguay, Argentina, and Colombia, providing the flexibility to work remotely. Know more about life at Rootstrap visiting <u>https://www.rootstrap.com/careers</u></p><p><em>All of our candidate searches are covered under Uruguayan Law 19691 (the purpose of this law is to promote the inclusion of people with disabilities).</em></p><p></p>

Portfolio Stewardship</li><li>Proactively and organically communicates across client relationships to surface industry thought leadership, best practices, and drive a “doctors not waiters” mentality.</li><li>Coaches Triforces/Managers to understand the client's business drivers, develop relationships, and solve problems.</li><li>Builds client relationships across the executive ladder and regularly conducts Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other meetings to understand feedback, communicate team progress, establish value propositions, and drive change.</li><li> Communication &amp; Influence</li><li>Identifies and influences decisions using reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling.</li><li>Delivers presentations, workshops, and conversations that inspire confidence and influence decisions.</li><li>Navigates high impact and difficult situations with clarity and poise, making decisions that create value for our company and clients.</li><li>Brings energy to moments that matter, particularly new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.</li><li> Technical Leadership &amp; Solution Architecture</li><li>Technical Solution Leadership: Direct the technical definition and architectural design for the most complex client solutions, ensuring long-term viability, scalability, and security.</li><li>Mentorship and Technical Growth: Act as the primary technical mentor for Team Leads and Senior Engineers, elevating the team's technical bar through Deep Dive Sessions, design reviews, and the promotion of best practices.</li><li>Crisis Response (Troubleshooting): Intervene as the top technical expert in projects facing critical technical challenges or production failures to diagnose and define the mitigation plan.</li><li>Technical Pre-Sales: Lead technical conversations with new clients, estimate the technical effort for complex projects, and define the architectural scope for commercial proposals<br><br></li></ul><strong>Internal Applicant Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>An updated resume.</li><li>A one-page cover letter describing why you believe you are qualified for the role, including project contributions and/or prior career experience.</li><li>Identify a function or project manager, or a sponsoring Director who will be detailing and providing a letter of recommendation as to why they are sponsoring your candidacy for this position.<br><br></li></ul>

title: Product Manager - Merchant Experience (Argentina)
description: Job Title: Product Manager - Merchant Experience Location: Remote / Argentina Hiring Manager: Sarah Hill About Sezzle: Sezzle is a cutting-edge fintech company dedicated to financially empowering the next generation. With only one in three millennials owning a credit card and the majority lacking their desired credit scores, Sezzle addresses these challenges through a payment platform that offers interest-free installment plans at online stores. By increasing consumers' purchasing power, Sezzle drives sales and basket sizes for thousands of eCommerce merchants that it partners with. The salary range for this role is $4,000 - $6,000 per month (Gross in USD) About the Role: Sezzle is hiring a Product Manager to own the merchant-facing surfaces of our platform across the US and Canada. The experiences our retail partners use to integrate with Sezzle, manage their accounts, and get paid. You’ll be the sole product owner for merchant sign-up, sign-in, the merchant dashboard, and payouts, working hand-in-glove with our Sales and Business Development teams to turn merchant-acquisition momentum into a product experience that converts, retains, and scales. These are existing products with real usage and real revenue, and they’re ripe for disruption. We’re looking for a PM who sees that as the opportunity, not the obstacle. This role is fully remote, based in Colombia or elsewhere in Latin America, with working hours aligned to US Mountain/Central time (roughly 9am–5pm MT core hours). What you’ll own: You will be the sole PM across the full merchant-account surface: Merchant onboarding — sign-up, KYB collection, underwriting touchpoints, time-to-go-live, activation Merchant authentication — sign-in, SSO, session management, account recovery Merchant dashboard — orders, settlements, reporting, user and role management, self-serve configuration Merchant payouts — payout scheduling, reconciliation, statements, and dispute visibility (with support from adjacent payments and treasury teams on the underlying rails) The merchant-side roadmap — quarterly planning, prioritization, and trade-offs across all four surfaces above Out of scope: consumer-facing surfaces, marketplace and dining partner programs, and merchant geographies outside the US and Canada. How you’ll work — start in Claude, finish in our internal tools: This is a core expectation of the role, not a perk. You’ll use Claude as your default first tool for: Drafting PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria Analyzing merchant funnel data, churn signals, and onboarding drop-off Prototyping flows and UI before formal Design handoff Drafting merchant-facing communications, dashboard copy, and Sales enablement material Researching competitor flows and vendor capabilities Reading code in our GitLab repos and translating engineering changes into product-ready language You’ll then transition that work into our production tools: Jira for tickets and epics, GitLab for code review context, Figma for design handoff, Slack for cross-functional collaboration, and Confluence for documentation. Every PM at Sezzle is expected to operate this way. If you’re not comfortable starting in an AI tool and refining from there, this isn’t the right role for you. Key stakeholders: Engineering and Design — your daily delivery partners Sales (US and Canada) — your primary commercial partner for merchant pipeline, onboarding friction, and merchant retention signal Business Development — for partnership-driven merchant integrations Merchant Operations and Support — for post-launch signal and CX feedback loops Adjacent product and engineering teams — payments, treasury, risk, and platform teams who support the underlying rails behind the merchant surface Integration partners (external) — third-party platforms and providers whose APIs and capabilities power parts of the merchant experience What We Look For: 3–5 years of product management experience shipping B2B or merchant-facing software at a fintech, marketplace, payments, or SaaS company Strong written and spoken English; comfortable leading conversations with US- and Canada-based stakeholders Experience with at least one of: onboarding, dashboard or self-serve admin products, or payments and payouts Familiarity with BNPL, lending, or payments products is a strong plus Working comfort with SQL and the ability to read code (you don’t need to ship it, but you’ll read it) Demonstrated track record of working with Sales and BD as primary commercial partners Adept with AI tools as a daily driver, not a novelty — we encourage candidates to show off their AI workflows in our interview process Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. Compensation Thecompensation for this role is approximately $4,000 - $6,000 USD per month , with clear performance milestones and significant upside for high performers. Our ranges are broad to accommodate all types of candidates and encourage growth.

description: <strong>About NCR VOYIX<br><br></strong>NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. title: Senior Product Manager, Messaging Platform & AI Services
description: At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1. We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey. You will own the surface where humans and AI work together to serve customers — the messaging platform, the Virtual Agent and the channels it runs on, and the AI Services that make every human agent faster and every automated conversation better. This is one of the largest product surfaces at ASAPP, and it is where the promise of AI-native customer experience is proven or lost. You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans the Messaging Platform, Virtual Agent, the messaging and voice channels (Web, iOS, Android, Apple Messages for Business, RCS etc), and the AI Services that sit underneath them — AI-assisted human augmentation tools. You will become the go-to expert on this domain, internally and externally, and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders. The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves — as automation absorbs more of the conversation and the line between human and AI work keeps moving. The strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target, and will bring the technical and customer depth to anticipate what the right target is as AI develops in the space. What You Will Do You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely. Own the Messaging Platform — the application where live agents handle concurrent conversations, access customer context and knowledge, and collaborate with AI. Own the roadmap for agent productivity and the human side of every AI-assisted interaction. Define and execute the Virtual Agent and channels roadmap. Own how customers deploy automated conversations across Web, mobile SDKs, Apple Messages for Business, WhatsApp, RCS and voice, and how those channels stay coherent as the platform grows. Lead the AI Services that power the surface — such as automatic conversation summary, voice-to-text transcription and AI-augmented response generation. Own how these services improve agent handle time, quality, and compliance, and decide where to invest as model capabilities change. Reason directly about accuracy, latency, and trust tradeoffs rather than treating them as engineering-only concerns. Be the go-to expert on Human + AI collaboration. Represent this surface to customers and account teams, translate their pain into a prioritized roadmap, and be the internal source of truth on how these products work and where they are going. Own the external documentation for this surface as part of the product. Drive a docs-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them. Across All Of These Areas Set strategy and own the roadmap — balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets. Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery. Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage customer asks with product evolution bets; say no with clarity and evidence. Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data-driven. You can answer “why?” for everything on your roadmap. Who You Are Rapid, Practical Learning: You can drop into an unfamiliar domain and get to working expertise fast, teaching yourself what you need rather than waiting to be onboarded. You pair that with a practical approach to innovation — you know the difference between a novel idea and a useful one, and you ship the version that moves the business rather than the version that is merely clever. Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You do not wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the final owner; the outcome is yours. High-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer “what changed for the customer?” for everything on your roadmap. Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned. You know when to drive consensus and when to make a call. You are highly organized to keep everyone aligned. Real-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously. You do not save it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively. What You Will Need 5+ years of product management experience ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS and/or native AI platforms. Technical depth to engage credibly with engineers on model behavior, conversation design, channel architecture, and AI/ML tradeoffs — you can reason about accuracy, latency, and trust requirements, not just consume them. Demonstrated ability to own a complex, multi-surface product area with minimal oversight. Experience working directly with enterprise customers and delivery teams to translate pain into a prioritized roadmap. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving to clarity — you can structure an undefined problem before engineering has to. Track record of shipping: you have owned features from discovery through delivery, including the parts that are not exciting. What We Would Like To See Experience with human AI workflows or platforms and bonus points for products that are agent-facing or contact center products — agent desktops, workforce productivity tooling, or conversational AI platforms. Experience with AI-powered productivity features and a point of view on where they create real operating leverage. Experience with channels, CCaaS platforms, and multi-channel deployments. Comfort navigating AI/ML systems — not just as a user but as someone who can reason about model behavior, latency tradeoffs, and accuracy/trust requirements. Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment where the role definition evolved as the company did. Experience owning a product end-to-end. Comfortable approaching product development, ideation and management in a AI native workflow approach Benefits Competitive compensation Stock options Healthcare for the family group Mac equipment USD 150 per month in flexible benefits 3 weeks of vacation English lessons ASAPP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. If you have a disability and need assistance with our employment application process, please email us at [email protected] to obtain assistance. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Owner - CABA, Argentina
description: <p>JR0130472</p><p><br></p><p>As a key member of Western Union’s Product Management team based in Buenos Aires (CABA), this role plays a critical part in driving the development, evolution, and performance of products and services across the Pago Fácil and Western Union ecosystem. The position is responsible for supporting product strategy, identifying new business opportunities, managing the product lifecycle, and delivering commercial initiatives that enhance customer experience, transaction growth, and business profitability. Working cross-functionally with commercial, technology, operations, compliance, and marketing teams, the Assistant Manager will help bring innovative products and services to market while ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Drive the definition and execution of product strategies, roadmaps, and initiatives aligned with business objectives, market opportunities, and customer needs.</li><li>Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, including product development, enhancements, launches, commercialization activities, and continuous improvement efforts.</li><li>Identify growth opportunities through customer, market, industry, and competitive analysis, developing business cases, value propositions, pricing strategies, and recommendations to drive revenue growth.</li><li>Lead cross-functional collaboration with Technology, Operations, Compliance, Marketing, CRM, and Commercial teams to deliver product enhancements, go-to-market initiatives, and strategic projects.</li><li>Monitor product adoption, customer experience, operational performance, and financial results, providing recommendations to optimize outcomes and support profitability objectives.</li><li>Ensure stakeholder alignment and contribute to product governance, regulatory compliance, and the successful execution of product and commercial priorities.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Role Requirements</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related field. MBA is a plus.</li><li>2+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Business Development, Strategy, or related commercial roles supporting product strategy and roadmap execution, with knowledge of product lifecycle management, pricing strategies, customer value proposition development, and go-to-market execution.</li><li>Ability to analyze customer, market, and competitive insights, translate findings into actionable product recommendations, and effectively manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.</li><li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to develop business cases, support product launches, execute go-to-market initiatives, analyze product financial performance, including P&amp;L considerations, and monitor results through key metrics and KPIs.</li><li>Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Technology, Operations, Commercial, Marketing, and Compliance functions. Experience within financial services, payments, fintech, or related industries is a plus.</li><li>Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with experience collaborating across Technology, Operations, Commercial, Marketing, and Compliance functions in financial services, payments, fintech, or related industries.</li><li>Exposure to tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms is a plus. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and API-based integrations is desirable.</li><li>Intermediate English proficiency preferred</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Work Shift</strong></p><p>Western Union values in-person collaboration, problem solving, and ideation whenever possible. We believe this fosters common ways of working and supports how we execute initiatives for our customers. The expectation is to work from the office a minimum of three days a week.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>BENEFITS AND OTHER DETAILS </strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Benefits</strong></p><p>You will also have access to short-term incentives, multiple health insurance options, accident and life insurance, and access to best-in-class development platforms, to name a few. Please see the benefits below specific to your country. If applicable, additional role-specific benefits will be mentioned during your interview process or in an offer of employment.</p><p>Specific benefits for Argentina include:</p><ul><li>Marriage and/or birth gift</li><li>Gym membership discounts</li><li>Optional courses (agreements with online universities)</li><li>Gift vouchers for special occasions (Recognition points awarded)</li><li>10 consecutive days of leave for non-birthing parents</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Other Details</strong></p><p>As part of the application process, all applicants are required to take assessments. Western Union has partnered with a 3rd party provider to administer these tests. Applicants will need to provide their name and email address in order to process the assessments. If you have any questions, you may reach out to <u>careers@westernunion.com</u>.</p><p><br></p><p>We are passionate about honoring our employee's identity and fostering a feeling of belonging. Our commitment is to provide an inclusive culture that celebrates the unique backgrounds and perspectives of our global teams while reflecting the communities we serve. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, political affiliation, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, or veteran status. The company will provide accommodation for applicants, including those with disabilities, during the recruitment process, following applicable laws.</p><p><br></p><p>Estimated Job Posting End Date:</p><p>07-13-2026</p><p>This application window is a good-faith estimate of the time that this posting will remain open. This posting will be promptly updated if the deadline is extended or the role is filled.</p>

title: Product Manager/Owner, Chef Marketing
description: About CookUnity Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Team: Chef Marketing Chef Marketing is one of the most dynamic teams within CookUnity's BizOps organization. Our mission is to create tools, campaigns, and features that help chefs grow their business on the platform , improve their reach, boost sales, and foster loyalty among their customers — while also enhancing the end-to-end experience for our eaters. We operate as an "internal growth engine" — collaborating closely with other Product Managers, Data, Engineering, Marketing, and the Chef community to drive measurable impact on chef earnings, customer retention, and platform revenue. We ship fast, test constantly, and always put both the Chef and the Eater at the center of our work. Importantly, Chef Marketing also owns and contributes to customer-facing product experiences , especially around loyalty and retention. Many of the features and campaigns we build are seen and used directly by CookUnity eaters — from in-menu merchandising, to post-purchase experiences, to loyalty journeys. Our Current Initiatives Span a Wide Range Dynamic merchandising & personalization (Menu sorting, loyalty ribbons, post-purchase modules) Loyalty and retention campaigns (Autopilot, Free Meals, Winback) On-platform marketing tools for chefs (Campaign builders, performance insights) Automated promotional mechanics (Add & Save, Autopilot, Collections) CRM & segmentation frameworks Analytics & reporting for chefs Customer-facing product features to boost retention and lifetime value Experiments to improve chef performance and customer engagement We're looking to expand the team with a Product Owner / Product Manager who can help us move faster, deepen our data-driven decision making, and own small product areas and experiments end-to-end — both on the chef side and eater side of the marketplace. The Role As a Product Owner / Product Manager for Chef Marketing, you will play a hybrid role across Product, Analytics, and Execution , with growing ownership of scope over time. You Will Help define and track success metrics for chef-facing and customer-facing initiatives. Build dashboards and reports to monitor performance and drive decision-making. Partner with engineers and designers to develop new growth tools for chefs and loyalty experiences for eaters. Own product areas, features, or experiments end-to-end (discovery → spec → build → launch → learn → iterate). Manage backlog and prioritization for the initiatives under your ownership, coordinating directly with Engineering and Design. Collaborate with Data Analysts and BizOps to drive insights and surface opportunities. Work directly with our Chef Success team to understand chef needs and feedback. Juggle multiple concurrent initiatives (promotions, loyalty, CRM, growth tools) and re-prioritize as business needs shift. Responsibilities Own and prioritize the backlog for one or more Chef Marketing initiatives (promotions, UnityPass, Chef Portal tools, CRM/loyalty). Define and track KPIs for Chef Marketing initiatives (retention uplift, AOV impact, chef ROI, engagement, LTV uplift, etc.). Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering and design. Build dashboards, reports, and self-serve tools for internal stakeholders. Run deep-dive analyses to uncover trends, opportunities, and pain points. Partner with engineers to QA and validate new features pre/post launch. Design, run, and analyze A/B tests, translating results into actionable next steps. Lead product discovery: user interviews and feedback loops with Chefs and Eaters. Manage roadmap items and experiments from start to finish, adjusting scope as priorities shift. Contribute to the evolution of our CRM / Loyalty / Chef Growth tooling and customer experience features. Coordinate cross-functionally with Growth, Marketplace, Activation, Martech, and Data teams to keep initiatives moving. Minimum Requirements 1-3 years of experience as a Product Analyst, Product Owner, or Junior Product Manager — ideally in a consumer-facing, growth, marketplace, or e-commerce environment. Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum fundamentals (backlog grooming, sprint planning, prioritization frameworks). Strong analytical mindset — comfortable working with data and extracting actionable insights. Experience with SQL and/or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, Amplitude, etc.). Familiarity with A/B testing methodologies and statistical analysis. Excellent written and verbal communication skills — ability to explain data-driven decisions to non-technical partners. Collaborative team player — able to work across Product, Engineering, Marketing, BizOps, and Chef Success. Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Systems, or a related field — or equivalent experience. High ownership mentality: comfortable managing multiple initiatives in parallel and re-prioritizing quickly as business needs shift, without losing quality of execution. Self-starter — moves initiatives forward without needing detailed instructions. Preferred Requirements Experience in a marketplace, subscription, loyalty, or growth-focused product is a plus. Experience with product management tools: Jira, Figma, Notion. Knowledge of CRM / retention / lifecycle marketing concepts. Experience working with chefs, creators, merchants, or SMBs is a plus. Experience building internal tools or dashboards for non-technical users. Curiosity for how chefs grow their business and how to empower them with great tools. Experience contributing to customer-facing product experiences (landing pages, loyalty features, menu merchandising, post-purchase flows). Flexibility to adjust working hours occasionally around launches or campaign deadlines. Personal Traits Strong analytical thinker, but also user-obsessed: can balance data with empathy. Bias for action: gets things done and iterates quickly, holding a high bar for quality. Resolute and resourceful: unblocks themselves and moves initiatives forward with minimal hand-holding. Thrives on context-switching between multiple concurrent initiatives without losing focus. Comfortable with shifting priorities — sees re-prioritization as normal, not disruptive. Collaborative, low-ego, and solutions-oriented. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Excited about CookUnity's mission to empower chefs and delight eaters. Benefits 💸 Get paid in USD 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays 🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider 🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical 🐣 Paid Family leave 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises 🧘🏽‍♀️ Wellness perks: access to fitness subsidies to build a healthy lifestyle 🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster. 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability. A quick note for all candidates We’ve Recently Seen An Increase In Recruitment Scams Across The Industry, And We Want To Make Sure You (and Your Data) Stay Safe While Applying To CookUnity. We Also Want You To Know That We Take This Seriously — Sometimes, As Part Of Our Process, We May Ask For a Brief “proof Of Humanity” To Confirm That We’re Connecting With a Real Person, Not An Impersonator. Here Are a Few Tips To Help You Protect Yourself And Know What To Expect From Us Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page. We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

title: Product Manager Senior
description: 🚀 Buscamos Product Manager Senior Desde ACTIF Talentxpert acompañamos a Tecnom que se encuentra en pleno crecimiento regional en la búsqueda de un/a Product Manager Senior para sumarse a su equipo de Producto. Estamos buscando una persona con verdadera mentalidad de producto, que haya trabajado construyendo y evolucionando productos SaaS B2B, entendiendo las necesidades de los usuarios y transformando problemas complejos en soluciones de alto impacto. No buscamos un perfil orientado exclusivamente a gestión, coordinación o seguimiento de proyectos. Buscamos alguien que piense en términos de producto, clientes, adopción, valor y resultados. 🎯 Tu desafío Serás responsable de identificar oportunidades, comprender profundamente las necesidades de los usuarios y liderar la evolución del producto desde la estrategia hasta la ejecución. Trabajarás de manera cercana con equipos de Tecnología, Diseño y Negocio para asegurar que cada iniciativa genere impacto real en clientes y resultados de negocio. Tendrás un rol clave en la definición de prioridades, validación de hipótesis y construcción de soluciones escalables para un entorno SaaS B2B en constante evolución. 🧩 Responsabilidades Liderar iniciativas de producto de punta a punta. Comprender problemas y necesidades reales de usuarios y clientes. Traducir oportunidades de negocio en soluciones concretas. Impulsar procesos de Product Discovery y validación continua. Priorizar iniciativas considerando impacto, esfuerzo y alineación estratégica. Trabajar junto a Diseño y Desarrollo para asegurar entregas de valor. Analizar métricas de uso, adopción y resultados para orientar decisiones. Promover una cultura de experimentación, aprendizaje y mejora continua. Participar activamente en la definición y evolución de la estrategia de producto. Requisitos Experiencia comprobable como Product Manager en empresas de producto propio SaaS B2B. Experiencia liderando iniciativas de producto en entornos dinámicos y de crecimiento. Capacidad para identificar problemas, formular hipótesis y validar soluciones. Experiencia trabajando con métricas de producto, usuarios y negocio. Conocimiento sólido de Product Discovery, Product Planning y metodologías ágiles. Excelente capacidad de comunicación e influencia. Perfil hands-on, con autonomía y orientación a resultados. ⭐ Valoraremos especialmente Experiencia en scale-ups tecnológicas. Participación en productos con fuerte crecimiento y evolución continua. Experiencia trabajando con inteligencia artificial aplicada a productos digitales. Experiencia en industrias con procesos comerciales complejos o alta interacción con clientes. 🌎 Qué vas a encontrar Un entorno de producto con alto nivel de autonomía. Participación directa en decisiones estratégicas. Desafíos reales de escalabilidad y crecimiento. Cercanía con liderazgo ejecutivo y equipos multidisciplinarios. Cultura orientada al aprendizaje, la experimentación y el impacto. Si te apasiona entender problemas, construir soluciones y generar impacto real a través de productos SaaS, queremos conocerte. Beneficios Modalidad híbrida y flexibilidad horaria. Equipamiento tecnológico para trabajar cómodo/a. Obra social para vos y tus hijos. Reintegro por conectividad. Almuerzos en la oficina y actividades recreativas. Plan de capacitación continua y 10 días de estudio por año. Semana Tecnom: 5 días off adicionales para usar cuando quieras. Día libre por cumpleaños. Vacaciones flexibles y licencias extendidas (maternidad, paternidad, matrimonio). Beneficios por nacimiento, convivencia, graduación y aniversarios. Entorno diverso, colaborativo y con foco en impacto real.

title: Product Manager - Core Banking
description: ¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, conquistando mentes y corazones.<br><br><strong>Sobre este rol<br><br></strong>Cashea está construyendo su Core Bancario desde cero. El Core Ledger es la pieza donde queda registrado cada movimiento de plata: la compra financiada, la cuota que se paga, el desembolso al merchant, la comisión y hasta los ajustes manuales que salen de la conciliación. Hoy esa información vive repartida entre varios componentes que queremos unificar, para que la conciliación y los cierres de reporting y accounting salgan de un mismo lugar.<br><br>Buscamos un Product Manager que ya haya trabajado sobre un ledger o un core bancario y sepa qué problemas trae tenerla dispersa: balances que no cuadran, plata que aparece dos veces, un histórico que alguien puede reescribir. El rol arranca con decisiones de modelo de datos y de contrato entre sistemas.<br><br>Es un rol más de plataforma. Los clientes internos son hoy el modelo de BNPL, Contabilidad, Reporting y Finanzas Operativas. Parte del rol es decidir qué se resuelve con una API y qué necesita pantalla propia. Todos van a depender de que el número que sale de ahí sea el mismo que reporta la compañía hacia afuera.<br><br><strong>Lo que vas a hacer<br><br></strong><strong><strong>Diseñar la plataforma. Es el centro del rol:<br><br></strong></strong><ul><li>Decidir build vs buy sobre el motor de ledger y sostener la decisión con una prueba corriendo, no con un cuadro comparativo.</li><li>Definir el contrato de integración con cada producto: qué manda, qué garantiza y qué pasa cuando el mensaje llega dos veces, llega tarde o no llega.</li><li>Definir cómo se leen balances e histórico: latencia, consistencia y qué se le promete a cada consumidor. De esa decisión depende todo lo que después se pueda construir encima.</li><li>Armar la estrategia de migración desde el sistema actual, con el negocio operando encima, y fijar el criterio para apagar la fuente vieja.</li><li>Cerrar el circuito con el ERP para que el asiento nazca en el Core Ledger y llegue a la contabilidad sin que nadie lo cargue a mano.<br><br></li></ul><strong><strong>Diseñar lo que va encima del core:<br><br></strong></strong><ul><li>Definir el backoffice: dónde Operaciones, Soporte y Contabilidad consultan los movimientos de un usuario, el saldo de una cuenta y el detalle de un asiento, sin pedirle una query a Data.</li><li>Decidir qué se expone como API y qué necesita pantalla, para que sumar un consumidor nuevo no cueste un desarrollo a medida cada vez.</li><li>Dejar lista la capa de lectura para reportería y estadísticas: agregados, series de tiempo y cortes por producto y por período, que devuelvan el mismo número que el ledger.</li><li>Sostener la trazabilidad de punta a punta: que cualquiera pueda ir de una línea de un reporte hasta el evento que la originó. Le sirve al auditor y a quien está buscando un descuadre.</li><li>Priorizar en qué orden aparecen esos satélites, con el criterio de a quién le sacás trabajo manual primero.<br><br></li></ul><strong><strong>Diseñar el motor de asientos:<br><br></strong></strong><ul><li>El plan de cuentas y las reglas contables las define la contabilidad de cada producto. Vos diseñás el mecanismo que las soporta: cómo un evento de negocio se convierte en un asiento, qué dimensiones lleva cada línea y cómo se cambia una regla sin tocar código.</li><li>Definir el template de asiento y su versionado, para que sumar un producto o cambiar una cuenta sea configuración y no un desarrollo nuevo cada vez.</li><li>Acordar la granularidad con Contabilidad y Reporting: hasta qué nivel se abre cada asiento y qué preguntas queda poder responder después con ese detalle.</li><li>Ayudar a cada consumidor a definir qué eventos tiene que emitir y con qué payload para que el asiento se pueda armar del otro lado.<br><br></li></ul><strong><strong>Llevar la estrategia:<br><br></strong></strong><ul><li>Armar el roadmap de migración por producto, en un orden donde cada corte le sirva a alguien y no solo el último.</li><li>Priorizar entre lo que Contabilidad necesita para cerrar el mes y lo que la plataforma necesita para escalar.</li><li>Medir el avance con datos del cierre: descuadre que queda entre el Core Ledger y las fuentes actuales, horas de conciliación manual que salen del proceso, días que tarda el cierre.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Lo que este rol no es:<br><br></strong><ul><li>No es un rol de features de cara al usuario final. Hay pantallas en el roadmap, pero son internas. Es un rol troncal: de acá sale la capacidad de Cashea para escalar sus operaciones.</li><li>No es un lugar donde necesites saber de contabilidad. title: Learning Product Manager
description: Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a <strong>Learning Product Manager</strong><strong>!<br><br></strong><strong>Note To Applicants<br><br></strong><ul><li>Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America. </li><li>Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered. </li><li>Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority. </li><li>Interview Policy: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools during interviews are strictly prohibited. </li><li>Note: As part of the final stages of the selection process, contractors may be asked to provide professional references for a reference check. If you're selected, you may also be asked to update their LinkedIn profile. 🙂<br><br></li></ul><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>We are looking for a Learning Product Manager to take end-to-end ownership of a growing online learning and credentialing business.<br><br>This role combines product strategy, learning operations, course development, LMS administration, member enrollment, AI-enabled content production, and commercial support. You will own the evolution of the learning portfolio, from identifying new course opportunities and managing the product roadmap to overseeing course production, platform operations, credentialing workflows, and learner enrollment.<br><br>You will also lead the integration of an acquired credentialing business into the existing learning portfolio, including its course catalog, certification pathways, packaging, and distribution.<br><br>This is a highly autonomous role with significant ownership and visibility. The ideal candidate is a strong operator who can think strategically, manage projects end to end, work comfortably with AI tools, and maintain a high standard of quality across professional educational content.<br><br>Key Responsibilities<br><br>Product Strategy &amp; Roadmap<br><br><ul><li>Own and manage the learning product roadmap, prioritizing new courses, credential updates, and platform improvements based on learner and member demand.</li><li>Identify opportunities to improve and expand the course and credential portfolio.</li><li>Partner with subject matter experts and internal stakeholders to develop and update professional credential programs.</li><li>Balance product priorities with business objectives, revenue opportunities, and customer needs.<br><br></li></ul>Credentialing Business Integration<br><br><ul><li>Lead the integration of an acquired credentialing business into the broader learning portfolio.</li><li>Own the transition and repositioning of its course catalog and certification learning paths.</li><li>Evaluate existing content and prioritize updates based on certification demand and business opportunities.</li><li>Coordinate stakeholders and external partners throughout the integration process.<br><br></li></ul>Course Production &amp; Content<br><br><ul><li>Manage the end-to-end course production and revision pipeline.</li><li>Coordinate AI-assisted script development, research, fact verification, subject matter expert review, instructional design, and video production.</li><li>Manage external production vendors and ensure deliverables meet quality standards.</li><li>Review and quality-check written and AI-generated content before publication.</li><li>Continuously improve the course production workflow and identify opportunities to leverage new AI capabilities.<br><br></li></ul>Catalog Growth<br><br><ul><li>Identify and evaluate new educational content and courses to expand the portfolio.</li><li>Assess opportunities to build, license, partner on, or acquire new content.</li><li>Research market and learner needs to identify potential new credentials and learning products.<br><br></li></ul>Platform Operations<br><br><ul><li>Administer and maintain the learning platform on a day-to-day basis.</li><li>Configure courses, learning paths, certifications, learner access, benefits, coupons, and enrollment workflows.</li><li>Manage platform integrations and the systems supporting the learning business.</li><li>Troubleshoot operational issues and ensure a smooth learner experience.<br><br></li></ul>Member Enrollment &amp; Data<br><br><ul><li>Manage the process of enrolling member companies and learners into their credential benefits.</li><li>Maintain accurate enrollment and credentialing data as the source of truth.</li><li>Track enrollment performance and prepare regular reports.</li><li>Ensure data accuracy across individuals, organizations, credentials, and learning programs.<br><br></li></ul>Commercial Support<br><br><ul><li>Support pricing, packaging, and launches for new credentials and learning products.</li><li>Work with marketing on demand-generation initiatives and product launches.</li><li>Partner with membership teams to support customer engagement and retention.</li><li>Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for growth.<br><br></li></ul>Key Requirements<br><br><ul><li>Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent professional experience is preferred.</li><li>Background in product management, strategy, consulting, operations, EdTech, learning, or a related field.</li><li>Experience taking ownership of projects, products, or business functions from strategy through execution.</li><li>Strong experience using AI tools in your day-to-day professional work, with genuine curiosity about how AI can improve products, content, and workflows.</li><li>Hands-on experience administering an LMS or online learning platform.</li><li>Strong written and spoken professional English, with excellent editorial judgment.</li><li>Ability to review complex professional content and identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, unclear writing, or quality issues.</li><li>Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.</li><li>High attention to detail and strong data discipline.</li><li>Comfortable working independently and making decisions with minimal supervision.</li><li>Strong business judgment and the ability to connect product decisions with customer needs and commercial outcomes.</li><li>Genuine interest in areas such as ethics, compliance, governance, AI, or financial crime.<br><br></li></ul>Nice to Have<br><br><ul><li>Experience in EdTech, online education, professional credentialing, certification, publishing, or membership-based businesses.</li><li>Experience with Thinkific or other LMS platforms.</li><li>Experience launching or managing professional certifications or credentialing programs.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Schedule</strong>: Monday to Friday, full-time<br><br><strong>Compensation</strong>: USD salary<br><br><strong>Location</strong>: 100% remote opportunity<br><br>If this opportunity sounds good to you, <strong>send us your resume!</strong>

producto con una ejecución tecnológica eficiente, sostenible y orientada a resultados.</p><p><br></p><p>El desafío contempla la conducción de equipos multidisciplinarios y la coordinación transversal con distintas áreas de negocio, producto, operaciones y tecnología.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?</strong></p><ul><li>Transformar el roadmap de ECommerce en planes
